0.157.0.titulo: 🪟 Sound deck: the key editor got the window buttons and can dock to the grid
itens: 🪟 The key editor window now has the same buttons as the other windows: 🗕 minimize (only the top bar stays), 🗖 maximize/restore, ↩ dock and ✖ close — plus the ↺ that puts it back in its default place. The ✖ that sat loose in the middle of the form moved to the bar.

📌 New DOCKED mode (↩ on the bar; 🪟 detaches again): the editor opens right below the grid the key belongs to. With a folder open on the side, two editors coexist — the parent key’s below the main buttons (left) and the child key’s below the buttons inside (right). The preference is kept in this browser.
🗑️ Right-click on a key now offers “Delete” (in red, at the end of the menu), with the same confirmation as the editor’s 🗑️.

0.156.0.titulo: 🎭 Sound deck: the key changes color and face with the state
itens: 🟢🔴 On 🎬 OBS action and 🎛️ vMix action keys the outline now has two colors: GREEN when what the key controls is on (scene live, recording, source visible, sound active) and RED, same style, when the scene is in studio-mode preview or the audio is muted. Before, the preview scene and a muted mic lit up green — easy to mistake for “live”.

🎭 New “Emoji by state” option on those keys: the emoji tells the story too — 🎙️ talking / 🔇 muted, ⏺ recording / ⏹ stopped, 🔴 live / 👁 in preview… In “Automatic” the program picks the trio; in “I pick” you set the emoji for each color (🟢 on, 🔴 preview/muted, ⚪ off). The change comes with a little bounce, a key with an image gets the emoji as a corner badge, and without the program connected the usual emoji stays.

🎙️ The action “🔇 Audio mute” became “🎙️ Mute/unmute audio” (and “Mute” / “Unmute” in what it does) — the 🔇 looked like the state, not the action, and “audio mute” was confusing. Same for the vMix input and master.

👻 The mirrored OBS scenes — keys that appeared by themselves at the end of the panel’s deck without anyone creating them (the experimental Labs switch) — are gone for good. Only what you create lives on the deck: a scene key comes from the 🎬 creator or the editor, like any other.
🧹 In the key editor, ▶ Test now spilled over “What it does” (it was a square button holding a long label). Now it is a real text button and everything sits in its place.

0.155.2.titulo: 🔊 Overlay sounds: three leftovers from the sweep
itens: 🎁 With the die time at 0 (straight to the podium), the raffle 🏁 Finish only played on the panel — the live stayed silent even with “where: both”. Now it plays on both for every new draw, with or without the die.

🔇 The “tap here to enable sound” invite could stay lit forever if the card’s first sound pointed to a file that vanished from disk. Now only a real browser block lights it; a dead file falls back to a sound shipped with the program. And the editor preview no longer touches audio.
🧹 The old timer/die player is gone from the code for good — every overlay sound goes through the same engine.

0.155.1.titulo: 📋 Clipboard: nothing lost on close, and a blocked screen says why
itens: 📋 Whatever was sent to the clipboard right before closing or updating the program vanished on restart (the save was deferred and the program closed before it). Now it is written on the way out.

🔒 A panel opened over the network with the clipboard turned off in Security showed “No entries yet” — it looked like the history was not arriving. Now it says the clipboard is closed to the network (and where the streamer opens it), with the box and buttons disabled.

0.155.0.titulo: 🔊 Every overlay sound in one place
itens: 🔊 The ⏱ timer-end sound and the 🎲 raffle die sound moved house: they now live in “🔊 Overlay sounds”, under the 🏁 Finish of the 🕐 Clock and of the 🎁 Raffle — together with the sounds of every other overlay. The timer and raffle cards got a shortcut that opens the card already in the right place. Whatever you had set (file, volume and where it plays) was carried over by itself; anyone who never touched it keeps the program’s default sounds, and anyone who had silenced it stays silent.

🔉 The card gained what only the old way had: volume per sound (0 to 100) and a ▶️ Play button on every moment. And a redundancy is gone: anyone with the sound set in both places heard the timer end and the die play TWICE, on the panel and on the live — now it plays once, through the card.

🛠️ Important fix: since v0.77, a single sound set in “🔊 Overlay sounds” was enough for the program, when reopened, to fail to read the settings file and put EVERY setting back to factory defaults — the error was swallowed silently. The file is now always read, and the test that reproduces the case is part of the battery.

0.154.0.titulo: 🧲 Every dashboard button and tab can be rearranged
itens: 🐛 🎞️ Direct media ignored 🧲 Arrange the dashboard: you dragged it, it went back next to the 📋 Clipboard. The reason was internal — the list of what can be reordered lived in three places in the program, and the server had kept an old copy without Direct media; on save it dropped the key and the button always fell to the end. Now it goes where you drop it, like the others.

🧲 So this never happens to any button again, the list became ONE, shared by the server, the dashboard and the settings preview. A new feature enters it once and applies to all three — and a test checks that every tool button and every tab that exist in the dashboard are in it.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.150.0.titulo: 🔗 The update check goes straight to the right address
itens: 🔗 The program looked for updates at two addresses. The second was an old one that no longer answers, and every attempt on it waited out the full timeout before the program reached the one that works — on a poor connection, that was the difference between an update being slow and looking frozen. It now goes straight to the official address, keeping the usual fallback path for networks that block GitHub’s download server.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.147.0.titulo: 🧱 Each platform’s column shows up once it has a comment
itens: 🧱 In 🧱 Columns mode, a platform’s column appeared the moment the platform connected — and just sat there, empty, sharing the screen width with the ones actually talking. Now it is born with that platform’s FIRST comment. With six platforms connected and two of them talking, that means two wide columns instead of six narrow ones.

⏳ Anything that has already arrived counts as a comment: the day’s total the program keeps, what is on screen, and even what is still waiting its turn in the column’s own pace (🌊 Per column) — the column shows up together with the ⏳, not after it. And it is born on its own the instant the comment arrives: no switching tabs, no reloading.

🔇 Anyone who preferred the old way turns on “🔇 + Silent”, right next to “💬 + Unified” — connected but silent platforms get their columns back. That is also how you reach the 🔄 of a platform that got stuck without ever speaking. While nobody has spoken, the screen says the column will show up on its own when the first comment arrives.

0.146.0.titulo: 🔍 Avatar zoom works again for everyone
itens: 🔍 Zooming the avatar of someone writing from Telegram or WhatsApp showed the colored initial, as if they had no photo. They did: since v0.72 the program DOWNLOADS the profile picture from those two networks and keeps it on the computer. The catch was that the zoom only accepted internet addresses (https) and threw away the very photo the program had saved. Now it goes through — in the panel and on the public screen. The 🧪 samples too.

🛡️ Nothing was loosened: a local address is accepted only from the program’s own two folders and with a clean file name, checked character by character — no climbing out of the folder, no slashes in the middle. Any other kind of address (http, javascript:, data:, file:) stays blocked as before.

🖼️ And the quality was checked network by network: the zoom first tries the BEST image each service keeps, stepping down if it isn’t there — YouTube’s original, Twitch’s 600×600, Kick’s “fullsize”, Bilibili’s uncropped one. From Telegram and WhatsApp the program already fetches the largest the network gives. If none loads, the colored initial takes over: the screen is never left blank.

0.145.0.titulo: ✍️ Text arrives and leaves the way people wrote it
itens: ✍️ A viewer’s message now reaches the panel with the FORMATTING they used: *bold* shows as bold, _italic_ as italic, ~strikethrough~ struck out, and `monospace` in a code font. On WhatsApp that comes from the markers they typed; on Telegram, from the list of formatted spans the app itself sends alongside the text — and which until now was simply thrown away.

↩️ LINE BREAKS survived too. A message written across three lines used to arrive as one run-on line, in the panel, in the docked chat and on the public screen. Now it shows the three lines the person wrote.
🧮 And ordinary text stays untouched: “2*3=6”, “file_name” and “12/07” don’t turn into formatting by accident — the same rule WhatsApp itself uses.

✒️ The panel’s reply box gained a formatting bar: select the text and click B, I, S or M (or use Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I). Clicking again removes the marks instead of stacking them. If you’d rather, you can keep writing *like this* by hand. WhatsApp understands it directly; for Telegram the program translates at send time, escaping everything written so nothing turns into markup by accident.

🖋️ And the host’s name in a reply now has two shapes, your pick: on top, announcing (“So-and-so says:”, with a blank line before the message), or at the end, signing (“— signed: So-and-so”). The choice is remembered, just as the signature already was.

0.144.0.titulo: 💬 Panel replies quote the message again on WhatsApp
itens: 💬 In local-library mode (the free connector, no gateway), replying to someone from the panel sent the message LOOSE: it landed at the end of the conversation without attaching to the comment being answered. In gateway mode this always worked. Now both behave the same — the reply reaches the person’s WhatsApp quoting exactly the chosen message, with the original’s bubble above it.
📎 It holds for replies with an attachment too: a photo, audio, video or file sent from the panel arrives quoting the message it answers.
✂️ In a long reply, which the program splits into blocks, only the FIRST block quotes — as in gateway mode. Repeating the quote on every piece just clutters the conversation.

🛟 And when the original message is no longer at hand (the program was restarted, or the conversation is old), the reply still goes out, just loose. Better to arrive without the quote than not to arrive.

0.143.0.titulo: 💬 Contacts, events, polls and catalog reach the panel
itens: 💬 WhatsApp’s special cards — many of them from WhatsApp Business — never reached the panel: contact, event, poll, catalog product, order, group invite and live location. None of them carries text or a file, and the rule that discards empty messages threw them all away without a trace. Now each becomes a readable card: 👤 the contact’s name, 📅 the event with date and place, 📊 the poll with its question and every option, 🛍️ the product with title and price, 🧾 the order with items and total.

🛍️ A catalog product now brings its PHOTO too. The WhatsApp library couldn’t download it on its own (it looked for the address in the wrong place); now the photo is handed to it as the image it actually is, and it shows up on the card like any other.
💵 The price is written the way the currency’s own country writes it — R$ 4.500,00, not R$4,500.00. That is how WhatsApp shows it and how the seller listed it.
☎️ A contact card carries a vCard with a phone number inside. Only the NAME comes out of it: the number reaches neither the panel nor the screen, as has been the rule for everything since v0.64.

📨 Same story on Telegram: polls, contacts and the dice roll now arrive. And in WhatsApp’s gateway mode, a message type the program can’t draw yet at least ANNOUNCES that something came in, instead of vanishing silently.

0.142.0.titulo: 🧾 The attachment that doesn’t arrive now says why
itens: 🧾 When a WhatsApp attachment can’t be downloaded, the panel card now shows the reason, with technical details underneath and a 📋 that copies it all at once. The reason already existed — but only in the program’s console, which nobody opens. Those details hold platform data only (message type, format, size, whether it’s animated, whether an address and key arrived): nothing the person wrote, and no phone number.

🔄 An underlying fix for stickers and media that never arrived: when a download fails, the program now ASKS the paired phone to upload the file again before the second attempt. The library only made that request when WhatsApp’s server answered “not there” — and the common failure (a file that has aged out, or decryption that doesn’t add up) isn’t that case. That is why one sticker came through and the other didn’t.
📏 The 20 MB ceiling holds again. The declared size arrives as one of the protocol’s big numbers, and the old arithmetic couldn’t read it — the limit simply never fired.
🧭 When a message arrives with no file address or no key to open it, the card says so in plain words, instead of the scrambled error the library produced while trying anyway.

0.141.0.titulo: 👥 Only the direct conversation, if that’s what you want
itens: 👥 A new switch on the 📨 Telegram and 💬 WhatsApp cards, under 🔌 Connections: “Accept messages from groups, channels and communities”. Turn it off and only the direct conversation comes in — with the bot (Telegram) or with the stream’s number (WhatsApp); everything else never reaches the panel. It ships turned on, so nothing changes for anyone already using it.
⚡ The switch counts immediately: flip it and the very next message is measured by the new choice. No disconnecting or reconnecting in the middle of the stream.

🕳️ A hole was closed along the way: WhatsApp channels and broadcast lists passed as “direct conversation” and always came in, even with a specific group filled into the field. Now they are treated as what they are and obey the switch.
💤 With the switch off, the group field is greyed out and says why — no more filling in a group and waiting for messages that were turned away at the door.

0.140.4.titulo: 💬 A WhatsApp message no longer vanishes when its attachment fails
itens: 💬 When a WhatsApp message’s file could not be downloaded, the WHOLE message was thrown away — no card, no notice, no trace. The presenter never learned that someone had written. Now the card shows up saying “[sticker that did not arrive]” (or photo, video, audio, as the case may be) and the technical reason is written in the program’s black window.
🔁 And before giving up, the program tries the download a second time: WhatsApp’s decryption and servers stumble now and then, and the second try usually settles it.

📦 Disappearing messages, “view once” and edited messages arrive wrapped in an envelope — and the program did not open that envelope, so it found neither the text nor the attachment and the message vanished. Now it opens it.

0.140.3.titulo: 💬 The WhatsApp library downloads without needing git
itens: 💬 Baileys asks for one of its own parts (libsignal) through a git address — and git does not come installed on Windows. Without it npm stopped with “An unknown git error occurred”, which is the error that showed up on the card. The SAME libsignal, from the same authors and the same repository, is published on npm: the program now fetches it from there. Nobody needs to install git.

🩹 Anyone who already tried before is fixed too: the redirect is added to what was already in the folder, and the old dependency list (still pointing at git) is moved out of the way so npm resolves everything again.
🔍 Checked end to end with git hidden from the program: Baileys 6.7.24 and its 92 dependencies land, the library loads and signs the credentials — which is exactly what libsignal is for.

0.140.2.titulo: 💬 Downloading the WhatsApp library works again
itens: 💬 Downloading the local WhatsApp library (the free connector, no gateway) failed with an “error 4294963238” that explained nothing. The reason: the destination folder had no package.json, which npm requires — without it npm gives up, and it also goes looking for one in the folder above, all the way up to the program’s own. Now the folder is prepared first, as a closed little project just for the library, and npm runs inside it.

🗣️ When something goes wrong, the message now says what happened. It used to show the TAIL of npm’s output (the footer “a complete log can be found at…”), exactly the part that explains nothing; now it shows the line where npm explains the problem, with the path to the report at the end. And the message speaks your language in all 10.
⏱️ An npm that hangs no longer leaves the card spinning forever: past 10 minutes, the install is ended with an honest notice.
🩺 And if npm is not on the computer, the message now says where to get it: it comes with Node.js, at nodejs.org.

0.140.1.titulo: 🎧 The audio minutes no longer slip out of the pill
itens: 🎧 On the public screen the audio player’s clock could get pushed out of the pill and clipped at the card’s edge. The 48 little wave bars refused to shrink, and the clock paid the bill. Now the wave gives up its space first; if it still does not fit, the clock’s type shrinks; and when it is really tight, it shows only the elapsed time, without the total. No more cut-off numbers on screen.
📋 On the panel the arithmetic was the same: in a narrow column the time and the speed selector were eaten by the media clipping. The wave now shrinks there too.

0.140.0.titulo: 🎙️ What the person said becomes the comment on screen
itens: 🎙️ A subscriber’s audio or video on the public screen: the file still shows up as always, and the comment area now shows the transcript — what the person said, written out for the audience to read. (It is the local transcription from 🧪 Labs, running on your computer.)

🔈 With no transcript ready the screen is no longer mute: it shows “[audio message]” or “[video message]”, according to the file playing — the audience knows what is going on instead of staring at an empty card.

✍️ When the person also wrote something along with the audio, their text stays right where it always was and the speech comes just below it, discreetly. In that case, with no transcript, no marker clutters the card: there is already something to read.
⚡ A transcript that gets ready with the comment ALREADY on air walks in by itself: only the comment area is repainted — the card is not rebuilt and the audio does not restart.
📋 On the panel, the draft stays open below the player when the audio came alone, and collapsed when a written message came with it — one click on “✍️ Transcript” opens it, and it stays open.

0.139.0.titulo: 📱 The QR code got a face of its own
itens: 📱 On the Themes page, with the 📱 QR widget selected, there is a new block: “The code itself”. You can change the shape of the little squares (square, rounded corners, dot or diamond), the shape and color of the three corners, the color of the code, the color and opacity of its background, the margin around it and the gap between the little squares.
🫥 The background can disappear entirely: with opacity at zero, the live scene shows through behind the code — no white square.
🎨 Five presets settle it in one click: Classic, Soft, Dots, Diamond and No background. The fine-grained selectors sit right below, for anyone who wants to fuss over it.

✅ And the program tells the truth about scanning: a notice beside it warns when contrast got low, when the colors were inverted, when the margin is too tight, or when a transparent background will leave the QR at the mercy of the scene.
🔍 Every look was checked with a real QR reader: all five presets still scan. And whoever changes nothing sees no difference at all — the default is the same black on white as ever.

0.138.0.titulo: 🖼️ The profile photo that arrives late now shows up
itens: 🖼️ Twitch, Kick and Bilibili do not send the writer’s photo along with the comment: the program goes and fetches it, and that takes a few seconds. By then the comment could already be on the public screen — and it stayed there with the initials forever. Now the photo slips into the featured card on its own when it arrives, without rebuilding anything: the entry animation and any audio playing carry on.

📌 The same went for the queue: a comment sent to 📌 before the photo arrived stayed without one — and went to disk that way, surviving even a close and reopen. Now the queue gets the photo along with everything else.

🔁 And if the photo service stumbles at that exact moment — very common in the first seconds of a live, when the channel bot (StreamElements, Nightbot and friends) and the crowd all arrive at once — the program goes looking again on its own from time to time. Before, someone who wrote only once was left with the initials for the rest of the stream.

0.137.0.titulo: 🧹 One click wipes every test comment
itens: 🧹 Next to the 💬 “send test comment” there is now a 🧹. It clears out, in one go, EVERY fake comment you sent: from the columns, the queue, the saved ones and the featured comment on the public screen.
🎁 The raffle entries they created go with them — fake names no longer compete in your 🎁. That includes entries left over from earlier tests.

👀 The 🧹 stays hidden while there is no test comment on air: someone who never tested need not even know it is there. And nothing real is touched — comments from flesh-and-blood people stay exactly where they are.
🎛️ It also works from external control (Stream Deck and friends), with the “Delete the test comments” action.

0.136.0.titulo: 🏷️ Source credit on direct media — “Source: @handle · site”
itens: 🏷️ 🎞️ Direct media now carries a source credit onto the public screen: a pill right under the media, with the same look as the name shown under the enlarged avatar. It works for images, video, audio, site frames and in fullscreen too.

✍️ It arrives filled in from the address itself: when the link carries the handle (x.com/someone/status/…, tiktok.com/@someone/video/…), the credit reads “Source: @someone · x.com”; with no handle in the address, just the site. The opening word follows the language you picked. And the text is yours: write whatever you like, however you like.

👁️ A 🏷️ switch turns the credit on and off instantly without erasing what you wrote — and touching it never reloads the media already on air. Every new media brings its own credit, never inheriting the previous one.
🎛️ You can also write it and switch it from external control (Stream Deck and friends), with the “Direct media: source credit” action.

0.135.0.titulo: 🐦 X on screen — and an honest word when a site refuses the frame
itens: 🐦 An X (Twitter) link in 🎞️ Direct media now opens the OFFICIAL post frame — the same one blogs use. The X page itself refuses to be opened inside a frame (that is its own rule), which is why you got that “page blocked” box; the official frame accepts it, and the post shows up properly, video and all.

🚫 For the other sites that refuse the frame (Reddit, Facebook and friends), OBS Social now asks the site BEFORE building anything. When the answer is “no”, the panel says so in plain words — instead of leaving you staring at a grey box — and points at the two ways out: the 🎬 extractor in 🧪 Labs or a 📂 file from the computer.
📺 And the public screen no longer receives a frame already known to be blocked: instead of sending the error box to the stream, the layer simply does not appear.

0.134.0.titulo: 🎬 Optional extractor: even Instagram and TikTok become video in our player
itens: 🎬 New in 🧪 Labs: the “Direct media extractor”. Some sites publish the video file nowhere at all (Instagram, TikTok and friends) — with the extractor on, OBS Social finds that video and shows it in OUR player, with play/pause, position slider, volume, speed, 🔁 repeat and ⛶ fullscreen.

⬇️ The program that does it (yt-dlp, free and well known) does NOT come bundled: one click in 🔌 Connections downloads the single file (~30 MB), just like the transcription engine already does. You can update or delete it whenever you like, and none of the video is written to disk — only the address is discovered, and the video keeps coming from the source.

🔎 While the search runs, the panel says what is going on instead of staying silent. If the site gives nothing away (a video only for logged-in visitors, say), the link stays as a frame of the site, as before.
⚖️ Every site has its own terms of use: showing third-party content on your stream is the streamer’s responsibility.

0.133.0.titulo: 🎬 “Grab just the video”: the link becomes our own video, with every control
itens: 🎬 Many sites publish the video FILE in their own meta tags — that is where WhatsApp and Discord get their previews from. Now, when a URL is loaded, OBS Social looks for that file (og:video, twitter:player:stream and the JSON-LD contentUrl). When it finds one, the media stops being a frame of the site and becomes our own video: play/pause, position slider, volume, speed, 🔁 repeat, 🎭 pitch and ⛶ fullscreen, all driven from the panel.

🔎 The program also asks the site what that address really is, instead of guessing from the ending. That fixes an ugly case: a PAGE whose address ends like a file (…/File:something.ogv) was treated as a video and played nothing. Now it opens properly — as a video if the file is found, as a frame of the site if it is not.

🔒 The lookup is watched: http(s) only, at most three redirects (each one checked again), eight seconds, half a megabyte, and never at addresses on your machine or your network — not even the 169.254.169.254 the cloud providers use.

🅼 Instagram and TikTok stay as a frame of the site: they publish neither the file (the page is just the shell and the login wall) nor a control API like YouTube’s. To get the controls in those cases, download the video and use 📂 Browse for a file on the computer.

0.132.0.titulo: 🎞️ Direct media: the video really plays, each site in its own shape, and a real “Browse”
itens: ▶️ YouTube would not play on the overlay. Outside OBS the browser silently refuses to start a video with sound before someone touches the page — so the embed sat on its poster while the panel preview played fine. Now, if the play has not caught on within 1.4 seconds, the program plays it MUTED (which the browser always allows) and lights the 🔇 invitation on screen; the first touch gives the sound back, from wherever it is. Inside OBS nothing changes: it starts with sound, as always.

📐 Each site in its own shape. Instagram and TikTok are portrait, and they were being put in a 16:9 box — black bars on the sides, a cut header and a scrollbar. Now the overlay and the preview use the ratio each site asks for (YouTube, Vimeo and Twitch stay landscape in 16:9) and no embed shows a scrollbar.

📂 “Browse” for a file on the computer became real. The Dropbox, Google Drive and OneDrive folders were vanishing from the list: on Windows they are junctions, and the program only recognised “folder” or “file”. Now it asks the system and they show up. The shortcuts at the top gained 📄 Documents and the cloud folders, and the known folders (Desktop, Downloads, Documents…) are also looked for inside OneDrive, where Windows usually moves them.

🔎 And it became easier to use: a filter to type and narrow the open folder, a count of what it holds (how many folders, how many media), a taller list and a better message when the folder only has subfolders. Pointing at a FOLDER in the path field now opens it instead of complaining.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.130.3.titulo: 🌙 The Default theme shows its colors again
itens: 🎨 In the 🎨 Themes gallery, the 🌙 Default card had four gray strips showing no color at all. It is the only theme that stores no colors — picking it clears yours and the program goes back to the factory ones — and that is what left the card mute. Now the strips show exactly the factory colors it wears: the background, the cards, the purple accent and the text. The other ten cards are unchanged, and loading Default still clears your colors as always.

0.130.2.titulo: 🖱️ The comment window shows the panel’s own row
itens: 🖱️ The window opened by the left click now shows the comment EXACTLY as it appears in the list: the same row, with the network’s colored stripe, the round avatar, the platform icon before the name, the badges (member, moderator, Super Chat), the text and the media. Only the row’s own buttons are hidden — the window’s buttons act now.

0.130.1.titulo: 🖱️ The comment window in the OBS Social look + queue in every tab
itens: 🎨 The window opened by the left click now uses the program’s look: title with icon, card in the chosen theme’s colors and the panel’s buttons — the main one in the theme’s accent, the others discreet and the remove-from-queue one in red. Each of the 10 themes dresses the window on its own (background, border, text and accent come from its colors).

📥 “Send to queue” now shows in EVERY tab and column — Super Chats and member comments can wait their turn too. Before, only ordinary comments had it, in the window, in the right-click menu and in the row’s own 📥. The 📥 Queue tab keeps its own set (send and remove, send, remove, cancel).
🪟 The window also moved up to the same layer as the program’s other windows: nothing covers it any more.

0.130.0.titulo: 🖱️ Mouse buttons on comments — left click opens the window, right click the menu
itens: 🖱️ Left-clicking any comment (in every tab) opens its window: avatar, name, text, media, network and time, with the buttons 📺 Send to screen, 📥 Send to queue and Cancel. In the 📥 Queue tab the buttons become Send to screen and remove from queue, Send to screen, Remove from queue and Cancel.

🖱️ Right click still opens the menu — and it gained 🔍 Expand avatar, next to Send to screen, the queue options and (on Telegram/WhatsApp) reply, timeout and ban. Right-clicking the photo itself still expands it directly, as always.
✨ The window closes with Esc, with Cancel or by clicking outside, and nothing is sent unless you say so. The 📺 and 📥 buttons on the row itself keep working as before.

0.129.0.titulo: 🎞️ Direct media — image, video or audio from a URL or from the computer, no upload
itens: 🎞️ New dashboard button: “Direct media”. Paste the URL of an image, a video or an audio (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, Twitch clip, Discord attachment, loose file…) or pick a file from the computer itself — nothing is sent to the OBS Social library: the file is shown from where it is.
👁️ Show/hide like the other tools, 🖼️ size on screen and ⛶ fullscreen for the audience — the same way as the media arriving from WhatsApp and Telegram.

🎛️ Complete remote player: play/pause, ⏮ restart, position bar, 🔊 volume, 🚀 speed (0.05× to 32×), 🎭 voice distortion and 🔁 loop — the dashboard commands, the public screen mirrors. On YouTube the player obeys too (play, pause, position, volume); on the other embedded sites show/hide, size and fullscreen apply.

📂 “Browse the computer” opens a folder browser (drives, Desktop, Downloads, Videos, Pictures, Music) listing only images, videos and audios — available only in the dashboard opened on the program’s own computer; over the network, use a URL.

🕹️ External control: new actions midiaDireta/url, mostrar, esconder, alternar, fechar, tocar, pausar, reiniciar, volume and telaCheia; /estado describes the media on air. 🧹 Clear screen also takes it off air.

0.128.0.titulo: 📢 Multiple Announcements — the main one + extras, each in its own place
itens: 📢 Announcements: you can now have more than one announcement on screen at the same time, just like the QR code and the winstreak. The 📢 card in the dashboard gained ◀ ▶ arrows to move between announcements, ➕ to create another one (up to 30 — it is saved) and 🗑️ to remove an extra. The main one never goes away.
✍️ Each announcement has its own text, its own 👁️ show/hide and its own ⏰ “hide by itself” (by the clock or by the timer) — one can leave at the set time while the others stay.

🖱️ In the Visual editor (Themes) each extra announcement shows up as its own item on the map and in the widget selector (“📢 Announcement 2 (extra)”…): its own position, size and style, in horizontal and vertical. The OBS screen draws one element per announcement.

🕹️ External control: the actions aviso/texto, aviso/mostrar, aviso/esconder and aviso/alternar gained an “id” parameter to pick which announcement (empty = the main one, as before); /estado lists every announcement. Backup, restore, “erase everything” and 🧹 clear screen handle all of them.

0.127.3.titulo: 📐 Themes page without horizontal scroll + ↘ handle of windows on narrow screens
itens: 📐 Settings: in smaller windows (below ~1430px) the page got a horizontal scrollbar — the main block took the width of its content instead of the window. It now never exceeds the window; bars and texts adjust inside.

🪟 Dashboard windows (🎁 raffle, 🔍 avatar and the docked tool cards): in a narrow window they were already born at the 92%-of-screen cap and the ↘ handle would not move sideways (nor downwards on a short screen). The cap now only applies until you resize: from then on the window grows freely, as detached windows already did.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.126.0.titulo: 🕹️ External control: Stream Deck and the like drive OBS Social (Labs)
itens: 🕹️ New in 🧪 Labs (experimental): any device or program that can open an address on your network controls OBS Social — Stream Deck (with an HTTP request plugin or the «Website» action), Loupedeck, Razer Stream Controller, Bitfocus Companion, Touch Portal, Macro Deck, Streamer.bot, the iPhone Shortcuts app, HTTP Shortcuts on Android, Node-RED... Every action becomes an address with a token; the device opens the address and the action happens. Nothing to install, and nothing gets in from outside the network.

📖 New «🕹️ External Control» settings page (shown while the switch is on): the token (with 📋 copy and 🔄 regenerate), the base address, per-device walkthroughs and the complete grouped action list — each with its address ready to copy, parameters to fill in (the address updates by itself) and a ▶ that really fires the action, to check before saving it on the device.

🧰 What you can control: clear the screen, highlight the latest comment (from any network or one) or a saved one, remove the highlight, release/skip the queue, media player, raffle (draw, hide, reset), likemeter, audience, winstreak, QR code, notices, clock, stopwatch and timer (start, pause, reset, duration, show), turn each connection on/off/restart, any Soundboard key (by id or name), any OBS Studio and vMix action (the same as the keys, with scenes and inputs listed), test comment and clipboard. For programs: «catalogo» (the JSON list), «estado» (the current snapshot, for Companion feedbacks) and «op» (the free operation — any dashboard operation by name).

🔐 The token is as good as the dashboard password and goes through the same gates: what only the local computer does (password, updates, restart, wiping data, backups, credentials) stays out even with a token; nothing gets in from outside the local network; 20 wrong attempts block the device for 10 minutes. The dashboard shows a 🕹️ notice for every action received.

0.125.0.titulo: 🧪 Labs page tidied up: every item collapses and expands
itens: 🧪 Every feature on the Labs page became a collapsible item, like the Themes page cards: collapsed, only the switch line remains (and it keeps turning the feature on and off); the ▸/▾ arrow beside it opens that feature's walkthrough and fields. Everything starts collapsed and each browser remembers what you left open.

0.124.0.titulo: 💬📨 One tab each: WhatsApp and Telegram split on the dashboard
itens: 💬📨 The single v0.123 tab became TWO, side by side after 👑 Members: 💬 WhatsApp and 📨 Telegram, each with its own real daily count, its own list and its own Labs switch (a network's tab shows and hides with that network's switch). The same care stays: the column card with media, reply and moderation, search, badges, the item cap, moderation clean-up and the draggable order in 🧲 Organize the dashboard.

0.123.0.titulo: 💬 WhatsApp/Telegram tab on the dashboard, next to 👑 Members
itens: 💬 WhatsApp and Telegram messages got their own dashboard tab, right next to 👑 Members — with the same care as the other tabs: the real daily count from the server (not just what is in memory), the same card as the columns (profile photo, media with preview and zoom, reply and moderation via right-click), the 🔎 search, badges that repaint, the item cap and moderation clean-up. The tab only shows with 📨 Telegram or 💬 WhatsApp on in 🧪 Labs, and can be dragged around in 🧲 Organize the dashboard — where the 🎛️ vMix tool also joined the line.

0.122.0.titulo: 🎛️ vMix from the dashboard (Labs, experimental) — modeled on 🎬 OBS Studio
itens: 🎛️ New switch in 🧪 Labs → vMix from the dashboard: OBS Social talks to vMix through the TCP API it ships with, already on (port 8099, no password) — no plugin, everything inside your network. The «🎛️ vMix Remote» page (right after 🎬 OBS Studio Remote) has the walkthrough, address/port and the on/off switches of each control block.

🎛️ The 🎛️ dashboard tool commands: 📡 stream and ⏺ record (with confirmation), 📤 external output, 🎞 MultiCorder, ⛶ fullscreen, ⬛ fade to black, 📸 snapshot and 🔖 marker; 📺 inputs (click picks the preview 👁 and 🔴 shows who is on air, from the vMix tally); 🔀 the 4 transition buttons, cut and fade; 🧩 overlays 1 to 4; 🔊 mixer with master and mute/volume per input; ⏯ media control; 🔤 title texts (GT/XAML) editable on the spot; and a 🧰 advanced block with replay, presets, scripts, shortcut key and any vMix function by name.

🎵 A «🎛️ vMix action» key on the Track Deck, twin of the OBS key: choose the action, the input (with suggestions from the connected vMix), the mode, and test with ▶ Test now. The key lights up on its own (on air, in preview, recording, muted, overlay on, media playing), joins a 🎛️ multi-action queue, and the key creator in the 🎵 card builds several at once.
🔒 Network users in restricted mode only command vMix with the same 🎬 switch as OBS enabled in Security. It is experimental and may change.

0.121.0.titulo: 🧪 Complete samples for every network + exclusive @identifier in 🎭 automatic
itens: 🧪 The test button now cycles through a sample comment for EVERY detail each network can send: on YouTube, owner, moderator, verified, new/6-month/1-year/2-year member with the level name, channel emoji, Super Chat in all 7 colors, Super Chat without text, foreign currency and Super Sticker; on Twitch, Tier 1/2/3 subscriber, Prime, founder, broadcaster, moderator, VIP, bits, partner, bot, name color, emote and badges with Twitch's own art; on Kick, founder, OG, verified, moderator, subscriber, broadcaster, VIP and bot with name color; on Bilibili, regular comment and Super Chat; in Support, donation and Pix; on Telegram, @username, profile photo, source group, location and media of every kind (photo, voice, video, static, animated and video sticker, file); on WhatsApp, number with and without a saved name (on screen it becomes 📱 Guest), profile photo, group and media (photo, voice, video, sticker, document). Sample media goes through the same quarantine as real media. So the highlight, the templates and the 🎭 automatic brackets can be checked without waiting for the stream.

🎯 A 🔤 word-in-name bracket starting with "@" is now an IDENTIFIER: it applies only when it is exactly that person — by the @ the network sent (Telegram, Twitch/Kick login) or by the whole display name — never by a piece of the name. Words without "@" keep working as a piece (Member, Gold…), as before.
🖼️ Telegram and WhatsApp profile photos (kept in the local quarantine) show again on the dashboard, in the highlight and in the pinned chat — they were falling back to the colored initials.

0.120.0.titulo: 🎨 Themes: the colors row no longer overlaps itself
itens: 🎨 In 🎨 Themes → Colors, each color's ↺ button crept over the next color's label and names like "Inner boxes" and "Soft text" wrapped onto two lines. Each color now gets a cell wide enough for the label, the swatch, the code field and the ↺ — nothing overlaps anymore, and on narrow screens the colors simply flow to the next line without clipping.

0.119.0.titulo: 🎟️ YouTube Super Sticker shows on screen like Telegram and WhatsApp stickers
itens: 🎟️ The Super Sticker image (static or animated) now takes the same path as Telegram/WhatsApp stickers: the program downloads it to the local quarantine and it arrives as subscriber media — on the dashboard with preview and zoom, and on the public screen through the 📎 Subscriber media block, big, following the scale and full-screen set there. Amount, colors and 🎭 automatic brackets stay those of a Super Chat. If the download fails, the sticker stays inline in the card, as in v0.118. The 🧪 Super Sticker sample does the same.

0.118.0.titulo: 🎟️ YouTube Super Stickers on screen + 🕒 membership-time bracket in 🎭 automatic
itens: 🎟️ YouTube Super Stickers (the paid stickers, static or animated) now enter the program: before, the connector simply dropped them. Each sticker arrives as a Super Chat with the amount, YouTube's colors and the big image in place of the text — it shows on the dashboard, in the 💰 Super Chats tab, in the pinned chat and in the highlighted comment, and counts in the 💰 amount and 🎨 color brackets of 🎭 automatic like any Super Chat.

🕒 New "membership time" bracket in 🎭 automatic: "from N months as a YouTube member" wears the chosen profile — the time comes from the member badge YouTube changes at 1, 2, 6, 12, 24 months... (0 = new member). The highest bracket reached applies, for regular comments and for Super Chats/Stickers with no bracket of their own. Order: color → amount → word → membership time → regular. The bracket's 🧪 puts a test member with those months on air.

0.117.0.titulo: 🗂️ Themes page reorganized — visual editor on top, highlight and chat right below, everything else expands/collapses
itens: 🗂️ New order of the 🎨 Themes page: the 🎨 Visual overlay editor stays on top; right below come 🎨 Highlighted comment and then 📺 Fixed live chat on screen; only then the other blocks (🧩 widgets, 🕐 clock, 🎁 raffle, 🔊 audios, 🎨 dashboard themes).

▸ Except for the visual editor, every block became an expand/collapse menu: click the title to open or close it (▸ closed, ▾ open). Blocks start closed, to keep the page tidy, and the browser remembers which ones you left open. The ◀▶↺ buttons in the title still work without opening the block, and reaching a field inside (Tab) opens the block by itself.

0.116.0.titulo: 🎁 Raffle with entry words, ◀▶↺ history and founders with the highest weight
itens: 🔑 Words to enter: in the 🎁 button of the dashboard and in 🎨 Themes → 🎁 Raffle, a text box with ➕ (or Enter) builds the list — up to 30 words, each with its own ✖. With words on the list, only those who type ONE of them in chat enter the raffle: the whole word, case-insensitive ("#raffle" counts as "raffle"; a phrase matches as a fragment). Empty list = everyone who talks enters, as always.

◀▶↺ Raffle history: the 🎁 Raffle card in settings got the Back, Forward and Default buttons, and they cover EVERYTHING in the raffle — words, tokens per tier, YouTube levels, dice, sound, winners' reply and the messaging networks. What you change in the 🎁 button of the dashboard also enters the history.

👑 Founders with the highest default weight: Twitch founder and Kick founder go from 3 to 5 tokens (above Tier 3, worth 4). Anyone still on the factory 3 moves up automatically; anyone who had changed the number keeps it.

0.115.0.titulo: 📏 The measure-mode dotted line can be made more visible
itens: 📏 Streamer request: in the 📐 panel of 🖱️ Arrange the screen, the new "Measure-mode dotted line" selector has three levels — Normal (as before), More visible and Very visible (thicker dashes with a dark halo, so it shows on top of light artwork). Everything grows INWARD: the outside edge is still the real size. It is a preference of this browser, like zoom and theme.

0.114.0.titulo: 📐 Typed in the manual sizer? The map shows only the white dotted real-size outline
itens: 📐 Streamer request: when you type Position, Width, Height or Size in the 📐 panel of 🖱️ Arrange the screen, the purple drag handles and the purple selection glow disappear — only the white dotted outline stays, so you see the real size of the piece or overlay with nothing on top. The handles come back on the next click on the piece/overlay (on the map or on its Select element card).

0.113.0.titulo: 📺 Each network with its own regular-comment profile — and the live look stops wearing off-screen artwork
itens: 🐛 Real case: seven YouTube-only profiles (regular + color tiers) and "only the first two worked; Twitch and Kick showed up distorted and without the artwork". The profiles were right — what showed up was the live look, which carried a real-size artwork anchored to the card (almost entirely below the screen) and wore EVERYTHING that matched no profile: Twitch, Kick, donations and the blue/cyan Super Chat with no tier. Now the 🎭 automatic block warns when the live look carries an artwork (with its name and the ↺ Default featured button next to it), and an artwork nobody positioned whose center ended up off-screen is born in the middle of the screen when you open 🖱️ Arrange the screen (profiles you already positioned are not touched).

📺 New in 🎭 automatic: "Per network" — YouTube, Twitch, Kick and Bilibili, each with its own regular-comment profile (only the profiles that network can wear are listed: its own and the 🌐 shared ones). Each selector accepts "same as the regular comment", "the live look (no profile)" or a profile of that network only — that is how Twitch and Kick get their own overlay/artwork without touching the YouTube profiles.

💰 New: "Super Chat or donation matching no tier wears" — by default the same profile as the network's regular comment (the blue Super Chat now wears "Comentário base" instead of falling to the live look); you can pick the live look or a specific profile.

0.112.0.titulo: 🎭 The 🎨 tab says what it is editing — and warns when the live wears another profile
itens: 🐛 Real case: the amount was formatted in 🎨 Highlighted comment with no profile open and "it was not applied" — the change went to the live look, but the comment on air was wearing the artwork profile via 🎭 automatic. The top of the 🎨 tab now shows the "🎭 Editing" selector (the same as in 🖱️ Arrange the screen, mirrored), and everything on that tab — colors, font, 💰 amount, ✍️ formatting — goes to whatever is chosen there.

⚠️ When the comment on air is wearing a profile different from the one you edit, the tab says which one and offers the "🎭 Open “profile”" button: one click and you adjust exactly what is on screen (the Arrange preview follows).

✍️ Audit of EVERY text field × every control, measured on the live: the amount piece's formatting and color now reach the pill (bold "No" and the own color did not beat its fixed bold/black); on widgets the formatting takes priority and flows down to the children — the clock time and the like meter numbers (👀/👍) ignored the chosen weight, color and spacing; and "Align" is no longer overridden by the centering of loose pieces.

0.111.0.titulo: 🎯 Perfect centering: map box = real piece, content in the middle of the box
itens: 🐛 The 🖱️ Arrange the screen map was not an exact 16:9 inside its border: the preview (scaled by width) was 0.9 px taller than the map, and everything near the bottom of the screen was ~1.5 px off vertically. The preview scale also rounded the width to an integer (up to 0.85 px off at the edge). Map and preview now match within ±0.05 px across the whole screen.

🐛 With the preview on, piece boxes had a minimum width/height: the like meter bar (10 px) got 7 extra px and its center moved down. The box is now exactly the real rectangle, and measurements have two decimals (0.01% instead of 0.1%).

🐛 Inside the piece, badges and the amount pill were aligned by the text baseline, ~1 px off the box center. They are now flex-centered — and ⌖ centers what you see, not just the box: positions saved with two decimals (0.1% of the screen was 1.9 px). Tested on every piece and every overlay: center and size within ±0.05 px, ⌖ within ±0.3 px.

0.110.0.titulo: ✍️ Formatting on EVERY overlay text + the ✍️ row always in sight
itens: ✍️ Text formatting (font, bold, italic, underline, uppercase, align, own color, outline and spacing) now applies to EVERY text, in any mode: the highlight's default card, the artwork profiles, the widgets in their usual presets (not only loose in pieces), the 📢 notice and the 📺 fixed chat (commenter's name and comment text). The 💰 "Plain text" amount also applies on the default card.

🎨 The same "✍️ Text formatting" block shows up in the tabs: 🎨 Highlighted comment (name, text, amount), 🧩 Customize widgets (the texts of the chosen widget, notice included) and 📺 Fixed chat (name, text) — with the "Which text" selector and a ↺ for each. It is the same formatting as the ✍️ row in 🖱️ Arrange the screen.

🐛 The v0.109 controls had landed at the END of the piece bar, which scrolls sideways — so they were off screen ("where are the formatting options?"). They now have their own row right below the bar, which wraps instead of scrolling: nothing stays hidden. The row follows the bar's rule: always on the page (empty, a hint; on a piece without letters, like avatar and artwork, the notice) and the map does not jump.

0.109.0.titulo: ✍️ Text formatting on every piece + 💰 amount as a pill or plain text
itens: 💰 New "Amount on the highlight" selector in the 🎨 Highlighted comment tab (and on the piece bar): "Colored pill", as it always was, or "Plain text", like the name and the text — just the number, in the piece's color, to fit the space your artwork reserves for it.

✍️ Every piece with text (name, text, amount and the widget pieces: titles, labels, numbers, time, caption, podium, audience) got its own formatting on the piece bar: font, bold, italic, underline, uppercase, alignment, letter outline (width and color) and letter spacing — on top of the color, shadow, rotation and opacity that already existed. "As is" keeps each piece's factory look.
🔒 Everything goes through the same server clean-up (fonts without quotes or semicolons, ranges enforced) and applies to the live look, the profiles and 📋 copy adjustments.

0.108.0.titulo: ⌖ Center-on-screen button on every overlay and piece card
itens: In the "Select element" bar, every card got a ⌖ button between 👁 and 🔒: one click moves the overlay (or the piece) to the MIDDLE of the screen. The overlay goes by its real box (with custom artwork, by the artwork, which is the anchor); the piece goes by its real measurement in the preview. A locked card does not center.

0.107.0.titulo: 💰 Amount always fits its box; the name centers too
itens: 💰 An amount with a chosen width/height shrinks its font until it FITS the box, whatever the fit mode: the box is the artwork's slot for the amount, and "$5.00 ≈ R$ 25,88" must fit where "R$ 20,00" did — before, a long amount spilled out of the slot.
🎯 The comment's name also centers in its box, like the other pieces. Its fit mode (shrink, clip with ellipsis or overflow) still applies, now to the centered content.

0.106.0.titulo: 🎯 New custom artwork is born at the center of the screen
itens: Every newly chosen custom artwork (uploaded or swapped in the selector, on the live look or on the profile being edited) is born CENTERED on the screen, at real size and without rotation. Dragging from the middle to anywhere is easier than guessing where each kind of artwork should start. Once placed, it stays where you left it.

0.105.0.titulo: 🖼️ With custom artwork, the artwork anchors the Highlight — and the preview always shows what you are editing
itens: 🖼️ With custom artwork active, the "Highlight" rectangle on the map becomes the ARTWORK ITSELF: it anchors the whole set. Moving the Highlight moves the artwork and every piece together; the invisible default-card box (part of OBS Social's default overlay) leaves the map — no handles and no Width/Height in the 📐 panel. Resizing the artwork is done on the 🖼️ Your art piece.

🐛 "I can't move the badge": with 🎭 automatic on, a test comment on air (a member, a Super Chat) dressed a PROFILE in the preview while the map edited the live look — the box sat in one place and the badge in another, and dragging did nothing. With no profile open, the preview now always shows the look you are editing; a line tells which profile the live would wear for that comment, so you can open it in the 🎭 Editing selector if you want to adjust it.

📏 When you grab an overlay or a piece, the editor measures again on the spot: the drag starts from where the thing is NOW in the preview (artwork just loaded, sample swapped...), with no jump on the first move.

0.104.0.titulo: 🎯 Content centered inside each piece's box
itens: Every piece with a chosen width or height (except the comment's name and text, which follow their own rule) now CENTERS its content in the box: badges, amount, avatar and platform icon used to sit at the left and top of the resizable selection.
👤 Avatar and platform icon with a box become a centered SQUARE — one chosen side sets the size; with both, the smaller one wins. Before, they stretched to fill the box and turned into an ellipse.

🧩 Same rule for widgets in pieces: QR title, like-o-meter and winstreak labels and numbers, clock time and caption, giveaway title and podium, audience total and rows center in their box. The QR code itself and the like-o-meter bar keep filling the box.

0.103.0.titulo: 🗺️ Pieces free to go anywhere on screen, preview always with a real example, and map boxes at the exact size
itens: 🐛 The artwork (and any piece) could NOT go anywhere on screen: its position is a % of the card and was capped at −200 %/+300 % — on a 120 px tall card the artwork could rise no more than 240 px and never reached the top. The cap is gone: every piece of every overlay goes anywhere on screen (and beyond), by mouse or via the 📐 panel.

📺 The editor preview ALWAYS shows the real overlay: with nothing on air it places a LOCAL sample comment (with the 💰 amount when the type is Super Chat) and every switched-off widget appears with sample data — clock, notice, QR, like-o-meter, giveaway, winstreak and audience. None of it reaches the live: 🧪 remains the button that puts the sample on air (in OBS too). The ✍️ letter counter applies to the preview at all times.

📏 The box of EVERY overlay and EVERY piece on the map is the real measurement from the preview — position and size — including widgets and extras (QR 2, Winstreak 2), which used a guessed rectangle before. Dragging, stretching by handle and typing in the 📐 panel match the real overlay pixel for pixel.

🐛 Stretching a free-positioned widget by the right/bottom handle shifted its left corner (the overlay anchors at the center of the estimated box): the position is now compensated on every handle and the opposite corner stays put.

🏷️ Each piece's tag only appears on hover or on the selected piece, and the others get a discreet outline — what you see inside the map is the real piece (avatar, name, badges, amount, text), with nothing covering what you are adjusting.

0.102.0.titulo: 🖼️ Artwork becomes a real piece — true size, no stretching, no tagging along with the badge — and the editor stops jumping
itens: 🐛 The highlight artwork (image or video) showed up STRETCHED: it was drawn as a percentage of the default card box (max width × card height) and forced to fill it — an 1840×586 lower-third became a squashed 640×120 strip. Images and videos alike.

Now the artwork is a piece like any other: it starts at the file's REAL SIZE (width and height on automatic), Size (%) scales the whole file, choosing one side keeps the proportion, and only with BOTH sides chosen does it stretch to the box — when that is what you want. Switching artwork resets the box so the new one comes in at its own size.
🔁 Anyone with artwork in the old default (100% × 100% of the card) is moved once to real size — in the settings and in saved templates. Choices made after that stay as they are.

🐛 "I move the badge and the artwork moves too": on the map, the selected artwork rose above every piece and, covering the whole card, stole the click from the badge, the name, everything — you thought you were dragging the badge and dragged the artwork. Selected artwork now stays under the pieces (its handles remain on top).

📌 The editor canvas does NOT change size or position: the 📐 panel, the piece bar, the size slider, the sample letters field, the profile status, the template-in-editing notice and the artwork thumbnail now have reserved room at all times — appearing or disappearing no longer pushes or narrows the map. (That was what made the overlay "get modified by something that shows up" on every click.)

📐 Correct tracking when moving and resizing: the Highlight's X/Y position comes from the REAL measurement of the card in the preview also in pieces mode (it used to be a corner estimate: 653/907 instead of the real 640/920); the estimate, when there is no card in the preview, uses the overlay's own 40 px margin; the two "Width" fields became "Maximum width" (classic card) and Width × Height (card in pieces); and the map rectangles lost the border/padding that skewed the percentages.

🏷️ With the preview on, the map becomes outlines only: the overlay and every piece show up FOR REAL inside the rectangles (as the artwork already did) and the labels become small tags at the outer corner — you stretch and position looking at the real thing, not an emoji.

📏 With no card in the preview (sample off air), the Highlight box no longer jumps to a wrong estimate: the artwork keeps its last measurement and the corner is computed with the real size of the card in pieces.

0.101.1.titulo: 🎬 The video warning now catches render .mov files (ProRes/alpha) — the ones that went black with no explanation
itens: 🐛 The warning that debuted last version called a file good too early: it only waited for the browser to READ the video's details. A render .mov (ProRes or QuickTime with alpha, the default After Effects export) passes that test — duration and size arrive — and still no frame decodes. Result: black artwork on screen, with no warning at all.

Now the test waits for a REAL FRAME to show up. If no frame comes, the warning says what to do: export as WEBM (VP9 with alpha) when the background has to be transparent, or MP4 (H.264) when it does not.
❓ A FAQ entry with the whole explanation came along too — "I uploaded a video as artwork and it came out black on screen. Why?" — so whoever lands in the same spot finds the answer without asking.

0.101.0.titulo: 🎬 Video artwork: the editors now accept every media format — and warn when the file will not open
itens: 🐛 Uploading custom artwork as a video could come back with "File type not accepted", without saying what does work: the upload format list was short and left out .mpeg, .mpg, .wmv, .asf, .flv, .f4v, .3gp, .3g2, .ts, .mts, .m2ts and .vob — and, among images, .svg, .tif, .tiff, .heic, .heif and .jxl.
Now every real media format goes in (image, video and audio), each served with the right type so the browser can play it. What is not media — programs and pages — stays blocked as always.

⚠️ And most important: not every video PLAYS in a browser (OBS shows the overlays inside one). Before, an .avi or .wmv became a black card with no explanation. Now the editor tests the file as soon as it lands and says: "the browser cannot open this file — convert it to MP4 (H.264) or WEBM".
🎭 In the mold bar, artwork that does not open is not put on: the warning shows and the card stays as it was, instead of erasing what you already had.
The same rule applies to the 🎵 Track Deck: a video in an unusual format becomes a 🎞️ video key (before it became an audio track by mistake) and the warning is the same.

0.100.0.titulo: ✍️ The commenter NAME color — in the featured card, the pieces, the panel and the avatar zoom
itens: You could pick the comment text color everywhere, but the NAME color only existed in the 💬 fixed live chat. Now it exists in the 🎨 Featured comment too (standard card AND overlay in pieces) and in the 🖥️ panel, under Themes → Panel.
🎨 Four options, the same in all three places: that screen's usual color, the social network color, "the color the service itself sends" and a single color you pick.
"The color the service itself sends" is the color the person chose in chat: only Twitch and Kick send it — on the other networks the name takes the network color instead of having no color at all.
🖥️ The panel also gained the comment TEXT color (it was the theme's only), with an ✖ beside it to go back to the theme color whenever you want. Panel only: the live does not change.

🔍 The name in the avatar zoom follows the color picked for the featured card, and the name color travels inside the 🎭 mold — each mold can have its own. Anyone who changes nothing stays exactly as they were.

0.99.0.titulo: 🧪 The Sample now works for ANY overlay — you pick which one
itens: The 🧪 Sample only knew how to put a featured comment on screen. Now it has a selector beside it: 💬 Featured, 🕐 Clock, 📢 Notice, 🔲 QR Code, 👍 Like meter, 🎁 Giveaway, 🏆 Winstreak and 👥 Audience — each one comes up with made-up content so you can adjust position, size and pieces without waiting for a live stream.

🎯 "What I am editing" is the option that comes selected: the 🧪 puts on screen exactly the overlay selected on the map (the extra ones — QR 2, Winstreak 2... — follow their family). Switching overlays in the editor already switches what the button will show.

What was on air COMES BACK when you take the sample off: your notice text, your QR code, your winstreak and the audience counts are saved first and returned to the letter — a test does not erase what you had prepared.

It is one sample at a time, and the button tells the truth in any tab: while one is on air it reads "🧪 Take off screen", even if you reload the page or open the editor in another browser. Nothing gets left behind on the live by accident.
The 📺 fixed chat and the 🖼️ fullscreen media have no sample (they show real media): with one of them selected the button goes dim and explains, instead of pretending it did something.

0.98.1.titulo: 🐛 Turning on 🧩 "Overlay in pieces" no longer steals the focus to the featured card
itens: With 🎯 "Only what I am editing" on, clicking 🧩 "Overlay in pieces" dragged the whole screen to the featured card: anyone editing the clock, the raffle or the like meter landed on the featured comment and lost what they were doing.

Now the overlay you picked stays picked — and it shows up taken apart, with its pieces on the map and in the "Select element" bar. The featured card is only chosen on its own when nothing was selected, so the pieces show up right away, as it always did.

0.98.0.titulo: 📐 Every overlay piece with real width, height and size — starting with 💰 Amount
itens: 🐛 The 💰 Amount obeyed nothing: it had no width or height sliders, and Size made no difference — the tag was FORCE-shrunk to fit the card, so it sprang back to its old size. Now Amount is born in "overflow" mode: the size is the one you pick. Anyone who prefers the old behavior chooses "shrink" in the piece's fit selector.

📐 Width and height now exist on EVERY piece — the featured card and every widget — not only on the art, the name and the text. 0 = automatic (the piece is the size of its own content), which is how they were all born: nothing moves for anyone who already had things arranged.
🐛 Widget pieces applied only the width: the height was stored and thrown away at drawing time. Both count now, in the editor and on the live.
🧑 With a box chosen, the content fills the box — that is what finally makes the avatar and the network icon (whose size was fixed in "em") obey both sliders.

📏 On the 🖱️ Arrange the screen map, an automatic piece's rectangle now carries its REAL measurement from the preview. Before it was the size of the label ("💰 Amount") and had nothing to do with the tag on screen — the handles stretched a lying rectangle.

0.97.0.titulo: 🎯 Focus now clears the elements bar — and the diagonal dots resize proportionally
itens: 🎯 With "Only what I am editing" on, the "Select element" bar still listed the pieces of EVERY overlay — that was what kept showing up after the previous fix. Now only the overlay in focus opens its piece chips.
The other overlays do not vanish: their chips stay dimmed, with a dashed border, and one click on them moves the focus there. So you can switch overlays without turning 🎯 off and on again.

📐 The 4 diagonal resize dots (the corners) now stretch width and height TOGETHER, in the same proportion — no more skewing the artwork when you pull from a corner. The edge dots (top, bottom, left and right) stay free to stretch a single side.

The proportion applies to everything with a box: featured pieces, the unpacked featured card, widgets in pieces and the fixed chat — and it holds all the way to the end: when one side reaches its limit, both stop together instead of one going on alone and warping the design.

0.91.0.titulo: 🪟 Every window remembers where you left it
itens: 🪟 Any window you move, stretch, maximize or minimize — anywhere in OBS Social — comes back EXACTLY where it was after reloading the page and after closing and reopening the program. The memory belongs to each browser, so everyone who opens the dashboard (your PC, the phone, the second computer) has their own arrangement without disturbing anyone else’s.

🖼️ The Soundboard media window on the dashboard was the only one that always came back in the middle of the screen: now it is born in the place and size you left it. The 💬 reply window also became a real window — drag it by the title strip and it starts remembering the corner you choose.
🗕 What was minimized stays minimized the next day (this used to be lost when the program closed), and a floating window left open comes back open, like in a real windowing program.

↺ Every window has a way back to the factory place: in the ⚙ of the small screens, in the ↩ of the tool cards and in a new button on the key editor window. And if you change monitor or resolution, what was saved is brought back inside the screen — nothing gets lost out there.

0.90.1.titulo: 🛡️ Security review of v0.90 — important fixes
itens: 📋 SERIOUS FIX: the clipboard history did not come back after closing and reopening the program — and the first new message erased what was saved. Now it comes back whole, ownerless files are cleaned up automatically, and entries whose file is gone don’t become dead links.

🔑 Restoring the 🔌 connections backup on another computer gave back the OBS password and tokens EMPTY, without warning: the key that opens the secrets now travels inside the backup, and any vault failure is written in the black window instead of passing silently.

🛡️ Doors closed: an outside site can no longer send a restore/import to your program (the origin check is now the same strong one used everywhere else); the restore only accepts into the library the file types the program actually uses, and has a space budget; and a file deleted at the exact moment of a download no longer takes the program down.

🕒 Signing in with the password over the network no longer freezes the dashboard: the check (deliberately much more expensive against brute force) moved off the main line — the program keeps answering while it checks — and file sending over the network has a limit, with "no limit" kept on the streamer’s computer.

📋 Anyone on the network with the clipboard turned OFF no longer receives the history (before, the content arrived and only the click was blocked). The dashboard also no longer disappears when a download fails, text is not lost when a send is refused, and the new messages got translations in all 9 languages.

0.90.0.titulo: 🔐 Clipboard with history, the Soundboard’s own backup and strong encryption
itens: 📋 The Clipboard became a shared, paginated HISTORY: every sent text is an entry (no size limit — screens see a preview and 📄 copies the whole thing) and you can now share ANY file, of any type and size, with direct ⬇ download and 🗑️ per entry.

💾 The Soundboard got its OWN backup: 📄 simple (a .json with just the keys) or 📦 full (a .zip with the keys + the library files). Restore understands both, puts the files back in place and still accepts any Stream Deck backup (which comes in as an addition, as always).

🎛️ Stream Deck importer audited and boosted: Stream Deck folders become real nested folders, each Multi Action becomes a 🎛️ multi-action button with the steps inside (delays become the ⏱), OBS Studio actions become 🎬 keys, each key’s grid POSITION is preserved and the 🖼️ art of each key comes along from the backup.

🔐 Every password the program keeps is now encrypted: the OBS password, bot tokens (Telegram/WhatsApp) and Pix secrets go to disk in AES-256-GCM, with a key that only exists on your computer (copying just the files reads nothing). The network password still becomes a scrypt hash — and new ones are born with a much higher cost against brute force.

0.89.0.titulo: 🪆 The big Track Deck reform — 7 requests at once
itens: 🪆 Folders inside folders: any button or folder can live inside any 🎛️/📁, as many levels as you want (only cycles are blocked). The side grid navigates inward, ⬅ goes up one level, and the 🎛️ multi-action queue also plays what is in inner folders, in order, respecting ⏱ waits.

🧭 The ➕ now asks WHICH key is born there (sound, image, video, OBS, multi-action or folder) — and right-click opens the context menu: 📋 copy (duplicates with everything inside), ✂️ move (cut) and 📌 paste (on an empty slot or inside a folder).

🔊 Batch volume on the folder: a box (no slider) in the 🎛️/📁 settings sets the desired volume and «✔ Apply to everything inside» writes it to ALL audios and videos there (subfolders included) in one click — no more one by one. It is not a master volume: each key stays individual.

🪟 The key editor became a real WINDOW: drag by the bar, stretch by the corner, 🗖 maximize, remembers its place. And back/close became independent — cell 0 is a useful button slot again, in settings and on the panel (⬅ lives on the bar). Button text centering was audited: exact (less than 2px off).

0.88.0.titulo: 📚 Each with its own library — Track Deck ≠ Overlays
itens: 🎵 What you upload via the Track Deck is now linked ONLY to it: files live in their own library (uploads/trilhas) and appear only in the Deck selectors — key sounds, images and videos. Sounds matched by the Stream Deck importer go there too.

🖼️ The Media page remains the custom Overlays library (backgrounds, frames, arts, raffle/timer/overlay sounds) — and no longer shows up in Deck selectors. Old keys that used files from there keep working.
⬆️ The Deck’s own upload now accepts sound, IMAGE and VIDEO: images/videos are born as ready-to-click media keys. Deleting works in both libraries, and «erase everything» clears both.

🧰 Extension audit done: .avi and .mkv were accepted on upload but had no type — the browser refused to play them; they now have the right MIME. .jfif (WhatsApp photos) and .apng joined; .html stays blocked. The audio (mp3, wav, ogg/oga, weba, m4a, aac, flac, opus), image (png, jpg/jfif, gif, webp, avif, bmp, apng) and video (mp4, webm, ogv, mov, m4v, avi, mkv) lists apply equally to the Deck and the Overlays.

0.87.0.titulo: 🚀 Full video and audio control on the panel — fine speed and 🎭 voice
itens: 🎞️ Deck video keys got a full player on the panel: besides play/pause/seek, there is now FINE SPEED — − and + buttons in 0.01 steps, a slider AND a box to type the exact value, from 0.05× to 32×. What you adjust also applies on the public screen, instantly.

🎭 «Distort the voice» switch: unchecked (default), the voice stays natural at any speed; checked, speed changes the pitch — cartoon voice when fast, deep voice when slow. Plus a display quality selector (sharp, softened or pixelated) — a local file has one quality; this finish applies on panel and overlay.

📺 The subscriber media remote player («Send to screen») got the same controls: fine speed and distortion commanded from the panel, applying on the public screen — with the position clock running at the right pace.

🎧 Panel audios too (now that WhatsApp and Telegram are in): the voice pill gained the ×N button that opens the fine controls — the same 0.01-step speed and the 🎭 voice switch, to listen to messages your way.

0.86.0.titulo: 🖼️🎞️ Image and video keys on the Deck + ✨ one overlay shadow
itens: 🖼️🎞️ The Track Deck gained two new key types: «Image on screen» and «Video on screen», with the same resources as sound keys in their own categories — name, emoji/face, color, own cell, ⏱ wait and even the 🎛️ multi-action queue. A click shows the media on the panel AND the overlay; another click removes it.

🪟⛶ Each key chooses how it appears in BOTH places: a resizable window (drag and stretch on the panel; on the overlay the size comes from the key) or full screen. The overlay shows only the image/video — no frame.
✨ In window mode the overlay outlines the media with a shadow equal to 🔍 show avatar. Video has its own volume, optional 🔁 repeat and leaves by itself when it ends.

🎚️ Audit done: each overlay had a different shadow and none was adjustable. Now the floating overlays share ONE shadow — 🔍 avatar, 📎 subscriber media, 🎧 audio pill, 🖼️🎞️ Deck media and 💬 featured card — with adjustable type (soft, marked outline or none) and opacity in 🎨 Appearance. The default everywhere is the «show avatar» shadow.

0.85.3.titulo: 🎛️➡ A single button to close the folder grid
itens: ✖ The folder grid had TWO buttons closing the same thing (the title ✖ and the ✖ in the first cell). Now only the title ✖ closes — the first cell became the dimmed ⬅ reminder (like on the panel, where that spot belongs to going back), and it remains the target where you drop a key to take it out of the folder.

0.85.2.titulo: 🎛️➡ Both Deck grids aligned on the same line
itens: 📐 The folder grid open SIDE BY SIDE started lower than the main one (its title strip pushed the rows down) — now the left column gets a mirror strip «main buttons» of the same height, and the rows of both grids start exactly on the same line.

0.85.1.titulo: 🎛️➡ Fixes for the side-by-side grid (from your screenshot)
itens: 📏 The main grid buttons are back to their usual size — the v0.85.0 change had made the grid shrink inside the new side-by-side space.
🖱️ Now ONE click on the 📁 folder or 🎛️ multi-action button is enough: the inner buttons open SIDE BY SIDE right away (no more double-click).

🧹 The old grid that appeared INSIDE the editor (below, showing everything at once) was removed — the side grid is the folder’s only grid, and the editor below is back to being just the button settings.
🔢 The folder grid respects the «how many buttons per page» setting (15, 10…), with its own page dots — just like the main grid.

0.85.0.titulo: 🎛️➡ The buttons inside a folder open SIDE BY SIDE on the Track Deck
itens: 🖥️ On the 🎵 Track Deck settings page, double-clicking a 📁 folder or 🎛️ multi-action button opens the grid of its inner buttons on the RIGHT SIDE of the main grid — using the empty space on screen. Both grids stay visible at once: the main one no longer disappears.

🖱️ You can drag keys from one grid to the other: drop on an empty slot of the other grid and the key moves home (in or out of the folder), landing exactly in that cell. Dropping on the side grid’s ✖ also sends the key back to the root.
🔢 Each grid has its own pagination (separate 1 2 3 dots and ◀ ▶), and the ➕ on empty slots creates the button in the right place — at the root or inside the open folder.
✏️ The editor below stays single and serves both grids: click any key — main or inside the folder — and its settings appear underneath.

0.84.0.titulo: 🎬 Every OBS resource becomes a REAL key on the Track Deck
itens: 🧲 New creator on the 🎵 Track Deck page: «Create OBS keys on the Deck». It lists EVERYTHING your connected OBS has — outputs (stream, record, pause, virtual camera, replay, screenshot, studio…), scenes, each audio mute, media, filters, collections, profiles and even ⌨️ hotkeys — with a checkbox for each. Check what you want, press ➕ and each item becomes a KEY on the Deck.

🖱️ Unlike the mirror scene keys (from the experimental switch, stuck at the end of the Deck), these are real keys: you MOVE them to any cell, rename, change emoji/color/image and delete like any other. What’s already a key shows as «already on the Deck» — no duplicates.
⌨️ The «Trigger OBS hotkey» action also joined the key editor: any OBS hotkey (even from plugins) can now be a key wherever you choose.
💡 Keys stay alive like on a Stream Deck: the on-air scene lights up, mute shows its state, stream lights up while live.

0.83.0.titulo: 🎬 Reorganized OBS window + 📊 OBS health and ⌨️ hotkeys (full coverage)
itens: 🗂 The 🎬 panel window was reorganized: the main actions (stream, record, pause, virtual camera, replay, screenshot) are ALWAYS at hand on top, and the rest became 8 collapsible sections with counters — Scenes, Studio, Audio, Sources, Media, Filters, Hotkeys and Profiles. Each section remembers whether you left it open or closed (per browser).

📊 NEW: the OBS health strip inside the panel — fps, CPU usage, memory, disk space, dropped frames (render + output + network, in red when they show up) and how long the stream/recording has been running. It’s the OBS footer, now on any device on your network.

⌨️ NEW: the OBS Hotkeys section — ANYTHING with a hotkey in OBS (even from plugins) fires from the panel. It’s the wildcard that closes the coverage: whatever has no dedicated button yet, fires via hotkey. (Off by default; enable it in «What appears in the control» on the Remote OBS Studio page.)

✅ Coverage audit: password connection (the crypto challenge is truly verified — a wrong password is refused), streaming, recording with pause and chapter, virtual camera, replay, scenes/preview, studio mode, transitions (including per scene), sources, mixer, media, filters, collections, profiles, screenshot — and now health and hotkeys. All validated end to end.

0.82.0.titulo: ⚙️ Dedicated pages for 🎬 Remote OBS Studio and the 🎵 Track Deck
itens: 📄 Remote OBS Studio and the Track Deck gained EXCLUSIVE settings pages, right after 🎨 Themes: the OBS connection and full control in one; the track keyboard, grid, button font and Stream Deck importer in the other. No more scrolling through Labs to find the controls.

🧪 The Labs tab is still the key: turn the 🎬 or 🎵 switch on and the matching page APPEARS in the menu instantly; turn it off and it disappears (anyone on it is taken back to Labs). The Labs card keeps only the on/off switch with the summary.
🔗 Everything stays the same inside: no setting changed its name or got lost — only its address on screen changed.

0.81.0.titulo: 🎬 Standardized entry and exit across all overlays
