itens: ✨ All overlays now enter and leave the screen with the SAME effect: the smooth fade the clock always used. The featured card (which slid up) and notices (which slid down) move to the new standard — and existing installs move along; only custom choices made in the editor stay as they are.

🔍 The enlarged avatar (and its extra instances) and the 📎 subscriber media gained a real EXIT: they used to vanish abruptly, now they leave with the same fade as the entry. For media, the sound stops instantly — only the visual fades away.
🎛️ Nothing got locked down: in the overlay editor you can still pick each element’s animation as always (slide, pop, zoom…). What changed is the factory default, now the same everywhere.

0.80.1.titulo: 🪟 Detached windows: unlimited resize + 🗕 minimize on all of them
itens: ↘ The corner arrow is truly in charge again: a detached window resizes WITHOUT LIMIT on every side — the caps of the toolbar-docked card (which locked width and height) no longer apply to free windows.

🗕 Every detached window gained a minimize button: it becomes a chip on the top bar (next to the mini-screen chips) and the chip reopens the window at the same place and size. The chip survives the tab’s F5, and reopening from the toolbar button also collapses it. That is the standard for every window from now on: 🗕 🗖 ↩ ✖.

0.80.0.titulo: 🕐⏱️⏳ Independent clock, stopwatch and timer + Notices that leave at the marked time
itens: 🕐 The three instruments became INDEPENDENT: switching tabs no longer stops anything — the stopwatch and the timer keep counting while you are on another tab, and each one has its own «show on screen». You can have clock, stopwatch AND timer on the public screen at the same time, stacked in the same widget. The tabs show who is running (●) and who is on screen (👁).
⏳ The timer gained DAYS and HOURS: typeable boxes for days, hours, minutes and seconds (with the usual +/-), countdowns of up to 100 days and the display showing «2d 3:00:00».

📢 Notices gained «⏰ Disappear on its own» with the full DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS format: fill only what you want (everything at 00 is the default and does nothing) and the message leaves when the clock matches the numbers — or, on the ⏳ line, when that much time remains on the timer. Once it fires, the numbers go back to 00.
✨ In the final stretch the Notice blinks as it already did with the timer — now also when the clock’s marked date/time is approaching.

0.79.0.titulo: 🪟 Every tool becomes a window + 🔍 avatar in multiple instances (windows plan complete)
itens: 🧲 ALL toolbar tool cards (📱 QR, 🎁 raffle, 📊 likemeter, 👥 audience, 🏆 winstreak, 📢 notices, 📋 shared clipboard, 🎵 tracks, 🎬 OBS, 🕐 clock…) now DETACH: drag the top strip of an open card and it pops off the toolbar into a free window — keep the raffle open in a corner while you work on the rest of the panel.

🗖 A detached card has real window buttons: 🗖 maximize/restore, ✖ close and ↩ to dock it back into the toolbar — and it NO longer closes on outside clicks or when another card opens. Position, detachment and maximized state are REMEMBERED per browser.

🔍✚ Multi-instance enlarged avatar: the avatar window’s ⚙ gained «Allow several instances» (off by default, applies to everyone). Turned on, enlarging ANOTHER person doesn’t replace: it opens one more little window on the panel and one more avatar on the public screen, each with its own size and its own ✖.
✅ With this, all 3 phases of the windows plan are complete: windows with classic buttons (v0.78), multi-browser behavior (v0.78) and now detachable tools + multiple instances.

0.78.0.titulo: 🪟 The mini-screens became real windows (Windows style)
itens: 🗖 The panel windows (🔍 enlarged avatar and 🎁 raffle) now have the three classic buttons: 🗕 minimize, 🗖 maximize/restore and ✖ close — plus they stay free to drag, resize by the corner and REMEMBER position, size and even maximized state, all per browser. That is the standard for every window from now on.

💻 Multiple browsers, zero disturbance: when someone opens a window, in the OTHER browsers it arrives MINIMIZED (a chip in the top bar). On each window, ⚙ brings two per-browser choices: «arrive already open» (off by default) and «sync with the other browsers» (on by default — turn it off and the window ignores what comes from them).
🔜 The MULTIPLE INSTANCES option for the same window (on the panel and the public overlay, off by default) is the next phase of this plan and arrives in a future version.

0.77.0.titulo: 🔊 Overlay audios — entrance, exit, screen-time and finish sounds
itens: 🔊 Every overlay (featured comment, subscriber media, QR Code, raffle, likemeter, audience, winstreak, notices and clock/stopwatch/timer) can now play sounds: on ENTRANCE (when it appears), on EXIT (when it disappears), during SCREEN TIME (while visible) and on FINISH (timer/stopwatch end and raffle reveal).

🎛️ Each sound has its own knobs: advance/delay up to 10s (negative skips the start of the file; positive waits before playing), repeat while the overlay is on screen (off by default) and how long the audio plays (0 = to the end). No file size or duration limits.

🖥️ And where it plays is your call, per sound: overlay AND panel (default), overlay only (the live hears it) or panel only (only you hear it). Configure everything in the new «🔊 Overlay audios» card (Screen & widgets tab); each overlay’s default sounds arrive in a future version.

0.76.0.titulo: 🛡️ Safety Mode — show the panel on the live without scares
itens: 🛡️ New button next to 🖱️ Arrange the screen: Safety Mode BLURS all comments in all panel columns (text, media and author photos) — to show the panel on stream without fearing an embarrassing comment or image popping up out of nowhere.
💧 The blur comes STRONG by default, with a slider to weaken it to whatever point you want — from a light veil to fully fogged.
💻 Per browser: each computer/tab picks its own (remembered there). The audience notices nothing — overlay, pinned chat and the subscribers’ screen stay normal.

0.75.1.titulo: Open screens refresh themselves when the program updates
itens: 🔄 The OBS browser source and open tabs (overlay, pinned chat, panel) now notice when the program was updated and RELOAD themselves — before, they reconnected to the new server but kept running the old code until someone reloaded by hand.

🌀 That is exactly why Telegram’s animated sticker showed as «📎 sticker» on the overlay: the OBS screen was still running the version from before animated stickers. Update (one last manual refresh of the OBS source may be needed THIS time) and from now on it is automatic.

0.75.0.titulo: Reply with photo, audio, video and file — like the subscribers
itens: 📎 The «Reply» box got an Attach button: replies to subscribers can now carry a photo, audio, video or file (up to 5 attachments, 20 MB each) — on Telegram and WhatsApp (both modes, gateway and local library).

💬 Send only text, only attachments, or both: the text goes first (quoting the original message, with your usual signature) and the attachments follow, each with the right type — photo as photo, audio as audio, the rest as document.

🛡️ All through the usual safe path: the file goes through the program’s local folder before leaving, restricted network mode still cannot reply, and a photo Telegram refuses (too big) resends itself as a document.

🌀 Telegram’s ANIMATED stickers (their own .tgs format) now really play, looping, on the panel AND on the public screen — before, only a frozen thumbnail came through. Video and static stickers stay as always.
📦 The animation player (lottie-web, open source) ships EMBEDDED in the program — nothing is fetched from the internet during the live, and each sticker’s animation is read only once.
💬 And WhatsApp? Its animated stickers are animated webp, which the program already plays naturally as images — arrives moving, keeps moving.

0.73.2.titulo: On templates and pieces, the audio player sticks to the card
itens: 🧲 When the highlight uses art, a template or loose-pieces mode (where the card is taken apart and the player can’t go inside), the audio pill now STICKS to the card: glued right below it — or right above, when the card sits at the bottom of the screen — always centered and with its width matched to the card’s.
🏃 It follows the card the whole time: during the entrance animation, when its position changes in the editor and on screen resizes — no more player lost in the middle of nowhere.

0.73.1.titulo: The audio player now lives INSIDE the comment on the overlay
itens: 🎧 On the default featured card, audio no longer sits in a floating pill mid-screen: the beautiful player (▶/⏸, waveform, time) goes INSIDE the comment card, right with the name and text — the full bubble, WhatsApp style.

🧩 On templates and loose-pieces mode the floating player remains — there the card is taken apart and the dedicated layer is the right place. Control stays fully on the panel (play/pause, position, volume), as always.
🎧 Incoming audios (voice messages and files) got a real player: round ▶/⏸ button, the audio’s WAVEFORM, time (mm:ss) and the file size — goodbye, gray default browser player.
🌊 The waveform is the audio’s real one (drawn from the sound, once per file) — you can SEE where the person speaks louder. Click anywhere on the wave to jump straight there.
📺 On the public screen the audio also looks beautiful: the same waveform visual, mirroring the panel’s remote player — the audience sees the wave fill up and the time move while the presenter drives.
☝️ On the panel, one audio at a time: playing a preview pauses the previous one by itself.

0.72.0.titulo: Profile photos on Telegram and WhatsApp messages
itens: 🖼️ Telegram and WhatsApp messages now arrive with the person’s PROFILE PHOTO — on the panel, the pinned chat and the public screen, just like the other networks. Works for both WhatsApp modes (gateway and local library).

⚡ The photo is fetched once per person and stored in the program’s local folder — no weight on the live and no refetching on every message. If it lands a moment after the first message, the messages already on screen get the photo retroactively.
🔒 Privacy respected: whoever hides their profile photo in Telegram/WhatsApp settings keeps showing the usual colored initials — no errors and no nagging retries.

0.71.0.titulo: Remote player: on-screen media only plays when the presenter hits play
itens: ⏯️ Videos and audios put on the public screen NO LONGER start on their own: the media shows up paused and waits for the presenter to hit play — no more sound barging in mid-sentence.

🎛️ Full player control right from the panel, in the «On air now» bar: play/pause (▶️/⏸), back to start (⏮), position slider with the time (mm:ss), and volume control — all driving the public screen in real time.
🔚 When the media reaches the end, the player pauses by itself and the button goes back to ▶️ — hitting play again restarts from zero.
🔊 The chosen volume carries over from one media to the next; taking the comment off air resets the player (position and state), ready for the next one.
🔧 Under the hood: the server now serves media with range support (HTTP Range) — that is what makes jumping to any point of the video/audio possible, including in the panel preview players.

0.70.1.titulo: Tokens truly remembered in the Telegram and WhatsApp connectors
itens: 🔑 A token typed once now LASTS: connecting again with the field empty uses the saved token — no more retyping every live or program restart. Typed a new token? It replaces the old one instantly.
💬 The token field on the cards announces when one is saved: «🔑 token saved — leave empty to use it (type to replace)».

🔒 A security hardening on top: the token never travels to browsers anymore — whoever opens the panel over the network only gets a note that it exists; the token itself stays only in the data/ folder on the streamer’s computer.

0.70.0.titulo: Subscriber media polished: on the public screen with scale and fullscreen
itens: 📺 Media sent to the screen now SHOWS FOR THE PUBLIC in any featured mode (classic card, molds and pieces): it lives in its own overlay layer — image and video centered, audio playing with an elegant 🎙️ badge.

🎚️ With a comment on air, the panel gains the «🖼️ Size on screen» slider (20% to 100% of the height) and «⛶ Fullscreen» — the media takes the public’s whole screen with a darkened background; changes apply instantly without restarting the video.

📐 In the panel, media got DYNAMIC sizing: it follows the column width and never overflows the card again (even with all columns active). And photos now enlarge with one click (magnifier) — Esc or a click closes.

🩹 Telegram now delivers what was missing: stickers (static, video and animated via thumbnail) and 📍 locations/venues — name, address and coordinates become text on the card. Same for WhatsApp (location in both modes).

🧰 Settings fixes: the «🛡️ Timeout and ban» card and the 🎙️ transcription one were leaking into ALL tabs — they now live only in 🔌 Connections; and the «🔄 Restart connections» card, which had vanished, is back in place.

0.69.0.titulo: WhatsApp with no subscription: the local library mode is here (QR on the card)
itens: 🖥️ The promised second way is here: the WhatsApp card in 🔌 Connections gained a mode selector — 🌐 Whapi gateway (paid) or 🖥️ LOCAL LIBRARY (free), the open Baileys library running 100% on your computer, no gateway and no subscription.

⬇️ Nothing comes bundled: the library is downloaded on demand (one click, via npm) into the data/ folder — and pairing is by QR right on the card: scan it with the live number’s WhatsApp (Linked devices) and done. The session is saved and survives restarts; a 🗑️ button deletes it to switch numbers.

💬 Everything works like the gateway mode: own column, private chats always in, group filter, media with preview and transcription, signed replies, ⏳ timeout via the local filter and 🚫 ban — which here uses WhatsApp’s native contact block.

⚠️ The WARNING stays the same: it is the same unofficial protocol as Whapi, with the same real ban risk — SECONDARY number dedicated to the live, always. What changes is only who does the bridging (and the price: zero).
🔁 The chosen mode is remembered: reconnect and restart-connections come back to the right mode by themselves.

0.68.0.titulo: WhatsApp is here: its own panel column, straight from the live number
itens: 💬 New Labs: WhatsApp joins as a full OBS Social network — its own panel column, presence in the unified column, filters, search, raffle and everything else. People talk DIRECTLY to the live number (and/or in a group you choose).

📎 Text, photo, audio, video, sticker and document come in with a preview on the card (and local transcription, if its Labs is on); media stays quarantined and only reaches the screen when you send it (right-click → 📺). Names that look like phone numbers stay masked on screen, as always.

💬 Signed replies work just like Telegram — and the reply QUOTES the person’s original message. ⏳ Timeouts hold via OBS Social’s own filter (WhatsApp has no native punishment); 🚫 bans also block the person’s number at the gateway.

🔌 The connection uses the Whapi.Cloud gateway (paid), by periodic polling — no webhook and no public address, everything on your computer. ⚠️ IMPORTANT WARNING: Whapi is NOT official from Meta and there is a real risk of the number being banned — use a SECONDARY number dedicated to the live, never your personal one. The Labs card explains everything before you turn it on.
🧩 An open-source library option running 100% on your computer (no gateway, no subscription — same risk) is coming in a next version.

0.67.0.titulo: Local transcription: subscriber audios become text on your computer
itens: 🎙️ New Labs: every audio and video subscribers send (Telegram today, WhatsApp soon) gets a text draft under the player on the panel card — you can read it before even pressing play.
🔒 Everything runs ON YOUR MACHINE with whisper.cpp (the open Whisper engine): nothing goes to the cloud, no audio leaves your computer.

⬇️ Nothing comes bundled: the engine (Windows x64), the ffmpeg converter and the 5 models (from the 75 MB Tiny to the most precise Large v3 Turbo) are downloaded on demand in 🔌 Connections, with progress bar, cancel and delete. Outside Windows, the program finds your installed whisper-cli and ffmpeg by itself.
🧠 You pick the model and language (or let it auto-detect) and can point to your own whisper-cli in the advanced field. The queue processes one file at a time so the live stays light.
⚠️ Something failed? The draft explains why in plain words (model not downloaded, needs ffmpeg…) and one click retries. Finished drafts survive a program restart.
🛡️ Downloading/deleting models and changing the engine command only works on the computer where OBS Social runs — nobody on the network can touch it.

0.66.0.titulo: Telegram and WhatsApp in the raffle: you decide if they join and what they are worth
itens: 🎁 The raffle window gained a new block for messaging networks: 📨 Telegram and 💬 WhatsApp each have their own on/off selector — and they start OFF: by default, people talking there do not compete.

🎟️ Since these networks have no sub/member tiers, you decide how many tokens each person is worth (1 to 100), just like the YouTube named levels. In an open raffle (no extra tokens), everyone is worth 1.
🚫 Turned the selector off mid-stream? Whoever was already on the list is instantly worth 0 tokens: they don’t count in the total and can never be drawn — no need to reset participants.
🔢 The panel’s token counter now refreshes the moment any raffle rule changes (extra tokens, selectors, weights).
🧑‍💻 Each row only shows with that network’s Labs on — the WhatsApp block is saved for when its connector arrives.

0.65.1.titulo: Telegram without needing a group: talk straight to the bot
itens: 💬 The group is now OPTIONAL: people can message the bot DIRECTLY (private chat) and everything lands in the panel just the same — text, photo, audio, video, preview, signed reply. And even with a group configured, private chats keep coming in (you can use both together).

🛡️ Private chats have no native Telegram punishment — and don’t need one: ⏳ timeouts and 🚫 bans hold via OBS Social’s own filter, with no failed attempt and no error toast. In groups, native punishment works as before (admin bot).
📖 The Connections and Labs texts were updated to make the direct mode clear.

0.65.0.titulo: Telegram has arrived: the live group becomes a panel column
itens: 📨 NEW in 🧪 Labs (experimental): Telegram via the OFFICIAL Bot API — free, risk-free and with no public address needed. Create a bot with @BotFather, put it in the live group, paste the token in 🔌 Connections and done: everything subscribers send lands in its own panel column (and the unified one).

📎 Photo, audio, video and documents arrive with a PREVIEW in the panel (embedded player): you listen/watch before deciding. On screen, media only appears when YOU send it (right-click → 📺) — then the image joins the featured card and audio/video play right away. Everything stays quarantined locally (data/, 500 MB cap).

⏳🚫 Timeout (30s, 5min, 1h, 1 day) and ban right from the column, via right-click: they ALWAYS apply inside OBS Social (the person’s messages don’t even enter the panel) and are also applied in the group itself when the bot is an admin. The lists live in Connections → 🛡️, with 4 collapsible blocks, 10 per page and ✔ Release.

💬 Reply to the subscriber without leaving the panel: a box with a fixed “Your name in the reply” (only leaves if you erase it), text and line breaks with NO limit (long messages are split automatically), Enter breaks the line and only Ctrl+Enter (or the button) sends — with the reply landing as a reply to the right message in the group.
👤 In the panel and on screen the preference holds: name > @username; and names that look like phone numbers stay mandatorily masked on screen, as in v0.64.

0.64.0.titulo: Sending to screen is right-click only now — and phone numbers never go on air
itens: 🖱️ HABIT CHANGE: a single click on a comment NO LONGER sends it to the screen — in every panel column, sending is now always right-click → “📺 Send to screen”. It’s the guard against accidental clicks mid-live, paving the way for WhatsApp and Telegram (where sensitive content risk is higher).

☎️ Phone numbers never appear on the live: any author that remotely looks like a phone number is mandatorily masked on the overlay, the pinned chat, the raffle podium and the zoomed avatar — becoming a nickname like “📱 Guest A7X” (always the same for the same person, revealing no digits). In the panel, the presenter still sees the real number.
📖 The FAQ and panel messages were updated for the new way of sending to screen.

0.63.0.titulo: Pix straight from the bank lands in Labs
itens: 💠 NEW in 🧪 Labs (experimental): Pix straight from the bank — the program queries YOUR bank’s Pix API (a Central Bank standard) and every Pix received becomes a support in the panel’s 💝 Supports tab, with the message the person wrote in their bank app and the amount showing as a Super Chat on screen. No middleman and no platform fee.

🏦 Ready profiles for Banco Inter (business account — MEI works) and Sicoob (business and individuals), plus a custom mode for any bank that follows the standard: paste the credentials and certificate from the bank’s developer portal and you’re set.

🔐 Credentials stay on your computer only (data/ folder) and never reach the screens; the first query just recognizes the Pix that already existed — only those arriving later show up in the panel. Live status (🟢/🟡/🔴) and a 🧪 sample Pix button to test without a bank.
💝 The Supports tab now appears with donations OR Pix turned on — each Pix support arrives with the “Pix R$ …” badge so it never gets mixed up with generic-URL donations.

0.62.1.titulo: Avatar letter back to the center of the circle
itens: 🧑 On the pieces overlay, the letter of the photo-less avatar (the “G” of someone with no image) was crooked, stuck in the corner of the circle: a more specific style rule was turning the centering off. The letter is nailed to the center again — on the pieces overlay and on the default card alike.

0.62.0.titulo: Overlay editor integrated with the horizontal and vertical screens
itens: 📱 Each overlay template now has its OWN position on the vertical screen: with a template being edited, the 📱 Vertical tab of the editor saves the position inside the template itself — the horizontal one stays untouched, and each template can live in a different corner on each screen.
🧲 A template without a defined vertical position auto-fits: centered in width and resting at the bottom, always fully inside the 9:16 screen — no overlay leaking out of the vertical live.
💰 The Super Chat amount on the pieces overlay is now a single line and shrinks until it fits the card: the converted tag (“$5.00 ≈ R$ 27.00”) broken into two lines over the message is gone.
📏 Switching tabs (🖥️↔📱) or templates resets the real-card measurement: a drag right after the switch no longer compensates with numbers from the previous screen.

0.61.0.titulo: Each overlay with its own network — YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Bilibili or shared
itens: 📺 Every overlay template now has a network selector in the visual editor: ▶️ YouTube only, 💜 Twitch only, 🟢 Kick only, 💙 Bilibili only or 🌐 Shared (works for all) — so a network’s overlay never gets mixed with comments from another one.
🎭 The automatic mode respects the choice: a template marked for one network only dresses comments from that network; the others move on to the next template that fits or stay on the default card.
🏷️ The template list shows each one’s network emoji (🎭 My template 💜), so one glance tells you whose it is.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.52.0.titulo: The grid shows up whole like the Stream Deck — and the mini-windows become real windows
itens: 🔲 THE GRID IS BORN COMPLETE: since the Board’s grid is predefined (4, 6, 8, 12 or 15), every slot shows up from the start — and each empty slot has a ➕ that creates the button right there (in the settings; on the panel the empty slots stay quiet, like in Elgato’s program).

📁 THE FOLDER’S GRID LIVES IN THE EDITOR: instead of the old "Open the folder (N keys)", the editor shows the grid inside the folder/multi-action button — the children as real keys (clicking opens each one’s editor) and the empty ones with a ➕ that creates the key in there.

🪟 THE MINI-WINDOWS NO WORK-BLOCKING: the raffle podium and the enlarged avatar became floating windows — the panel stays 100% usable with them open, and they only leave with an active click on their buttons.

🗕 THE RED ✖ BECAME MINIMIZE: truer to what it did (it only removed from YOUR screen). Minimized, the mini-window becomes a chip on the top bar, next to the 💬 test button — blinking slowly in green (the task is still active) or in red (the task has finished). Clicking the chip reopens it; you can even review the podium of an already finished raffle.

🖱️ MINI-WINDOWS MOVE AND STRETCH: hold the top and drag to any corner of the screen; the ↘ corner resizes, like the cards. And the tool cards (the 🎁 one used to overflow the browser) now measure the window on open: they never pass it, scroll inside and also get the ↘ handle.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+11 phrases per dictionary).
🎵 Track deck audio no longer shows up as "Image" among your custom art — it now has its own uploaded-audio list, and the art selectors only offer images and video.
🎯 Dynamic-size overlays (featured comment, notice, podium…) now stay CENTERED on the spot you chose in 🖱️ Arrange the screen — a giant message grows outward without wandering, at any scale.

0.51.0.titulo: The Board gets two folder types — and keys fly between pages when dragged
itens: 🎛️ THE FOLDER BECAME THE "MULTI-ACTION BUTTON": the new name says what it always did — a click plays everything inside in a queue (with the ⏱ waits) and holding opens it. Its look is now the 🎛️, so nobody confuses the two.

📁 SIMPLE FOLDER, THE NEW ONE: a new key type that ONLY holds other keys — a click opens it right away (no holding) and nothing plays by itself. Perfect for organizing without fear of firing a sound. In the editor, the old "Is a folder" became the "Key type" selector: 🎵 sound, 🎛️ multi-action or 📁 simple folder — and switching between the two folder types keeps the keys inside in place.

↔️ DRAGGING GOT POWERFUL: drop a key onto a page dot (1 2 3) or the ◀ ▶ and it changes page; drop it onto a folder and it goes inside; drop it on the ⬅ and it leaves the folder. Works in the settings and in the panel’s ✏️ reorder mode.
🔊 GROWN-UP VOLUME: the track editor’s slider was aligned with its neighbors, shows the number live (Volume: 42%) while sliding and got a box to TYPE the exact volume from 0 to 100.
📝 NAME WITH LINE BREAKS: the button name now accepts Enter (up to 3 lines on the key) and goes up to 50 characters — "BGM Jazz ↵ Cold night" finally fits nicely.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+14 phrases and 2 patterns per dictionary).

0.50.0.titulo: The raffle demands a reply from the winners — and every corner gets prettier
itens: 🎁 TWITCH FOUNDER IN THE RAFFLE: whoever wears the Twitch founder badge now earns their own extra tickets (new field in the panel’s 🎁) — before, they were worth 1 ticket like anyone else.
🤖 BOTS OUT ON THEIR OWN: anyone wearing the BOT badge (Nightbot, StreamElements...) doesn’t even enter the raffle’s participant list — no more hoping the robot doesn’t get drawn.
💬 THE WINNERS’ 1ST REPLY: each winner’s first comment after the draw shows in a balloon next to the podium — on YOUR panel and (if you want) on the public screen. Each has its own toggle in the 🎁.

⏱ REPLY TIMER WITH TWO MODES: a configurable timer (5s to 10min) for each placer to speak up in chat — the final 10 seconds blink in red, like the clock’s Timer. 🥇 One winner: if 1st doesn’t reply, they fade out with "⌛ Didn’t reply in time" and the chance MOVES DOWN to 2nd and then 3rd; whoever replies on their turn STOPS the timer for good. 🏆 Everyone wins: each placer gets their own turn, in sequence. Nobody replied? The raffle is ready to run again.
🎲 The raffle die now rolls for 3 seconds on screen (was 2.2s) — still adjustable.

🔒 THEME AND LANGUAGE GO PERSONAL: each browser/machine picks its own 🎨 theme (light, dark, retro...) and its own 🌐 language, without changing anyone else’s — they are the ONLY things that don’t sync between machines. Everything else stays identical everywhere.
↕️ BREATHING ROOM BETWEEN COMMENTS: new option in the panel settings to space out the comments in the columns — from 0 (glued, as before) to 30 px; the default is now 1 px.
🎗️ STRIPE ON BOTH SIDES: the little colored stripe that tells which platform the comment came from can also appear on the right edge — new option next to the spacing one.
🕐 THE FEATURED COMMENT SHOWS THE TIME: the featured comment now displays the exact time it was posted — on the public screen card and on the panel bar.
📊 THE LIKOMETER SHOWS THE PERCENTAGE: besides the numbers, it now says what % of current viewers left a like.
🔔 THE LIMIT OF 30 IS ANNOUNCED: the ➕ buttons for QR codes and winstreaks now count ("1/30") and turn off with an explanation when the cap of 30 arrives — before, the click simply did nothing.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+41 phrases and 8 patterns per dictionary — including old corners of the panel that still only spoke Portuguese).

0.49.1.titulo: The Stream Deck importer learns to open the real backup
itens: 🪆 THE REAL BACKUP OPENS NOW: the .streamDeckProfilesBackup file exported by Elgato’s program is a zip with OTHER zips inside (each profile is a .streamDeckProfile, which is another zip) — and the importer only looked at the first layer, found "nothing" and gave up. Now it opens the russian dolls: each profile becomes its own 📁 folder (named from the root manifest) with the sound buttons inside, even those on inner pages.

🚚 NO MORE 64 MB LIMIT: the screen now sends the backup directly over HTTP (no base64 bloat) and the server reads STRAIGHT FROM DISK, never loading the file into memory — backups up to 5 GB fit (the zip64 format of files above 4 GB is understood). The giant images and audio inside are never touched: only the manifests are read. Importing remains an operation only for the streamer’s computer.
📄 A SINGLE PROFILE TOO: picking a .streamDeckProfile (or .sdProfile) directly works — it becomes a single folder named after the profile, with no generic "Stream Deck" folder in the way.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+5 phrases per dictionary).

0.49.0.titulo: The Soundboard gets 📁 folders that play in a queue — and the Group field retires
itens: 📁 A KEY BECOMES A FOLDER: in the Soundboard editor, check "📁 It’s a folder" and the key starts holding other keys inside (each track’s "Inside folder" field says where it lives). The folder shows how many keys it has, and the look follows the keyboard — square, with an emoji or image.

▶️ CLICKING PLAYS EVERYTHING IN A QUEUE: clicking the folder fires the keys inside, in order, RIGHT ON THE SERVER — the queue keeps going even if you close the panel, and the ⏹ (or another click on the folder) cuts it instantly. Each key has the ⏱ WAIT: a box where you TYPE how long to wait before the next one — from 0s to 24h, in seconds ("12", "2.5") or as a clock ("1:30", "2:00:00").

✊ HOLDING OPENS THE FOLDER: hold the folder key (the time is yours: 0 to 5s, in the Soundboard settings) and it opens showing what’s inside, with the ⬅ to go back — on the panel and in the settings. With 0s, it opens on touch.
🎛️ THE IMPORTER CREATES REAL FOLDERS: each Stream Deck profile now becomes a 📁 folder with its buttons inside — and importing again reuses the folder that already exists, no twins.

🪦 GOODBYE, GROUP: the "Group" field (which did nothing since the keyboard makeover) was removed from the editor — folders are the real replacement. Removing a folder (with confirmation) drops its keys back loose onto the Soundboard.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+14 phrases and 6 patterns per dictionary).

0.48.0.titulo: OBS scenes join the 🎵 Soundboard and linking OBS becomes a walkthrough
itens: 🎬 SCENES ON THE SOUNDBOARD (experimental, off by default): a new switch on the 🎵 Soundboard card in Labs turns each OBS scene into a key at the end of the panel’s Soundboard — the on-air scene is marked 🔴, clicking switches the scene (in studio mode it picks the preview 👁) and the keys appear and disappear along with the OBS scenes. They are a live mirror: they don’t enter the editor or the ordering, and they obey the 🎬 permission of restricted mode.

🧭 LINKING OBS IS NOW EXPLICIT: the 🎬 OBS Studio card in Labs now carries a numbered walkthrough (OBS 28+ → Tools → WebSocket Server Settings → Enable → Show Connect Info → paste here and 💾). The Soundboard warns when scenes are on but OBS hasn’t connected yet, pointing to the card — and the ❓ FAQ repeats the full path.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+20 phrases per dictionary).

0.47.1.titulo: The black window speaks your language and shows the way
itens: 🌐 THE BLACK WINDOW SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE: the messages shown when OBS Social opens (and the new-version notice) now appear in the language chosen in the settings — and, on automatic, in the computer’s own language. No more mandatory Portuguese right at the start.

🧭 THE WAY TO THE PANEL: the opening notice now says in plain words to open the addresses in your browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox...) — and also shows YOUR network address (192.168...), so you can open the panel from your phone or another computer on the same WiFi.

🔤 ACCENTS AND ALPHABETS: the Windows launcher turns on the window’s UTF-8 mode (chcp 65001), so accents, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese display properly — no tricks that bother antivirus software.

📋 THE CLIPBOARD CLOSES THE LINE: in the panel’s default tool order, the 📋 is now always the last button — a new button (from Labs or a new feature, like 🎵 and 🎬) comes in BEFORE it. And it can still be dragged wherever you want in 🧲 Organize the panel.

🎨 NO MORE BROWSER LOOK: the panel’s 🔎 Search field, the file-upload buttons (media, tracks, backups) and the native bits (dropdown lists, number arrows) now wear the program’s theme. And if your 🎨 Theme has a light background, they follow the light look too.

0.47.0.titulo: The 🎵 Soundboard becomes a real Stream Deck
itens: 🎛️ SQUARE-KEY KEYBOARD: the board is now a grid of keys like the Stream Deck’s — in the settings AND on the panel, with the very same look. Pick the grid (4, 6, 8, 12 or 15 buttons per page); overflow becomes another page, navigated by the 1 2 3 dots and the ◀ ▶.
🪗 ACCORDION EDITOR: clicking a key opens ITS editing pane below (like in Elgato’s app) — clicking another closes the previous one and opens the new one. No more giant stacked cards.

🖼️ THE KEY IS YOURS: each button is a perfect square with an emoji OR your own background image, text wherever you want it (bottom, middle, top or no text) and its own border color. And the text font of ALL buttons adjusts in one place: size, bold and color (like the Stream Deck’s Global Font Settings).

↔️ DRAGGING ORDERS — IN BOTH PLACES: in the settings, drag one key over another to swap places; on the panel, the discreet ✏️ turns on order mode. The order is one and the same: change it on one side, it applies on the other.

🎚️ THE STREAM DECK’S 4 MODES: each track picks how it plays — Play/Stop (one at a time), Overlap (effects on top of the BGM, without killing it!), Restart (on top, from zero) and 🔁 Repeat/Stop. And fade got a direction: in, out, both or none — the Stream Deck importer already maps all of this from your buttons.
🗑️ REMOVING DONE RIGHT: remove now works instantly even with an empty track (the row used to get stuck on screen), and a track with content asks for confirmation before leaving.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+38 phrases and 13 patterns per dictionary).

0.46.1.titulo: Password fields now wear the theme
itens: 🎨 VISUAL FIX: password fields (the OBS password in Labs, the network passwords in 🔒 Security and the secret URLs) showed up with the browser’s raw look — white background, misaligned from the rest. Now they all wear the dark theme like the other fields, and the 💾 save, track upload and folder search rows are center-aligned.

0.46.0.titulo: OBS obeys the panel and the 🎵 Soundboard retires the Stream Deck — all in 🧪 Labs
itens: 🎬 OBS FROM THE PANEL (Labs, off by default): the panel’s 🎬 tool shows OBS scenes (in studio mode, clicking picks the preview and the button sends it on air), Swap Screen, audio source mute and live/recording (always with confirmation). Uses the remote control that ships with OBS 28+ (Tools → WebSocket Server Settings) — the conversation stays 100% inside your computer, and the password lives only in the data/ folder, never on the screens.

🎵 SOUNDBOARD (Labs, off by default): music and effects become buttons on the panel — and on your phone on the same network. One track at a time, fade swaps, looping BGM (🔁), per-track volume and fade, ⏹ stop everything, groups as folders — and each track picks where it plays: on the live (through the overlay in OBS), panel only, or both. Accepts MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A and more.

🎛️ STREAM DECK IMPORTER: point to the Elgato app’s profile backup and the "Play Audio" buttons become ready-made tracks — name, group, volume, loop and fade for each. The audio files don’t come in the backup, so you point to their folder and OBS Social finds and copies them by itself (even in subfolders).

🔒 SECURITY INCLUDED: commanding OBS over the network is a new selector in restricted mode (born blocked); OBS configuration, importing and folder search are local-computer-only operations; and tracks only play files from the program’s own folders.
❓ The FAQ got both new features, and backup/cleanup already know about tracks and the OBS connection (Tools and Connections items).
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+90 phrases and 10 patterns per dictionary).

0.44.0.titulo: The 8 handles everywhere, the 📺 Pinned chat joins Arrange the screen, and the live-numbers 🔢 badge
itens: ✋ 8 HANDLES ON EVERYTHING: every overlay in normal mode and every piece in 🧩 mode now has all 8 resize handles (4 corners + 4 edges). Pulling from the left or the top anchors the opposite side in place — the overlay never drifts away. Pieces only show the handles that have something to pull (a width-only piece shows no height handle).

📺 THE PINNED CHAT JOINED ARRANGE THE SCREEN: the fixed live chat is now a map item — drag it anywhere (not just left/right) and stretch it with the 8 handles. It is its own URL in OBS, so the real preview does not draw it — but position and size truly apply on the live. The toolbar's ↺ returns the chat to its usual side.

📏 CHAT HEIGHT: the Fixed live chat card gained a Height selector (0 = whole screen, as it has always been) — next to the Width that already existed. The other overlays were checked: the featured comment has width and height, widgets have size (and per-piece width/height in 🧩 mode).

🔢 THE LIVE-NUMBERS BADGE: while you pull any handle, a badge next to the mouse shows the size in real time IN THE SAME UNIT as that item's manual selector — px for featured/chat width, "× the letter" for the card height, % for widget and piece scale, and ° when rotating.

🪞 HOUSE RULE, NOW WRITTEN DOWN: every size adjustment made with the mouse on the map mirrors into the manual selectors instantly — always. The size sliders became finer (step 1) so they follow the mouse without rounding.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+12 phrases and 2 patterns per dictionary).

0.43.0.titulo: The theme dresses the overlays, the raffle shows up on the panel, ♿ Accessibility and a general inspection
itens: 🎨 THE THEME NOW DRESSES THE OVERLAYS: when you load a theme (from the gallery or a file), the featured card, the pinned chat and the widgets take on its colors, corners and font — controlled by the 🖥️ switch above the gallery (on by default; turn it off so the theme only changes the panel). The QR keeps its white background to stay scannable, and the Default theme returns the overlays to factory settings.

🎁 THE RAFFLE SHOWS UP ON THE PANEL: as soon as the result is out, the podium opens on the panel (in the style of the 🔍 avatar), with medals, photo and network of each winner — no need to look at the OBS screen. The ✖ closes it only there; the live widget keeps its own screen time.

♿ NEW ACCESSIBILITY PAGE: stronger contrast, reduced animations, reinforced visible keyboard focus, and shapes besides color in the status (the dot gains ✓/!/✕ — for color blindness). Each feature has its own on/off switch, applying instantly on every device. As a bonus: button hints now also become text for screen readers (the tooltip used to steal the title), and the connection dots introduce themselves by voice.

🔍 GENERAL INSPECTION: dead-code hunt (nothing left over), a security review of the backup — a malicious item name ('__proto__') slipped through a JavaScript gap and was blocked, with new folder-invasion and malicious-frequency tests in the security suite (54 locks) — and a vulnerability check across the new areas.

🌐 TRANSLATIONS UP TO DATE: +67 phrases and 2 patterns per dictionary (1111 identical keys across the 9 languages) — including old items that had never been translated: the Notices card (font, alignment, bold...), the Clock, loose buttons (Disconnect, copy...) and the screen resolutions.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.42.0.titulo: Art in 🧪 Labs, 💾 backup of everything, Founder/BOT badges, 🟡🟢🔴 dot and the ❓ FAQ page
itens: 🧪 CUSTOM ART MOVED HOUSE: the whole custom-art system (Your overlays, featured-card background, full-screen frame, widget backgrounds, fit and "The art IS the card") now lives in the Labs tab, behind the 🖼️ Custom art on the overlays switch — which, like EVERYTHING in Labs from now on, comes OFF from the factory. While off, no art enters the screen (your choices stay saved); the default overlay and the other customizations continue as always.

💾 BACKUP AND RESTORE: in the 🗄️ Logs and data tab, each item (⚙️ Settings, 📜 logs, 🖼️ media, ✓ read marks and queue, 🎁 participants, 🔌 channels, 🧰 QR/winstreaks) gained its own backup into a folder OF YOUR CHOICE, with the requested frequency ladder: manual, real time (saves as soon as something changes), 1s to 60s, 1min to 60min, 6h, 12h and 24h. A scheduled backup only writes when something really changed, the 30 most recent are kept, and ↩️ Restore brings back the backup you pick — instantly, no restart (only logs ask for one). For safety, backup and restore only work on the program's own computer.

🚦 CONNECTIONS IN 3 COLORS: the dot is now 🟡 yellow when connected WITHOUT a live on air, 🟢 green only with the live running, and 🔴 red when the connection failed — on the panel and in the settings, with the text telling the story.

🏷️ BADGES: Founder applies to Twitch AND Kick (Twitch has it too — it was already read, now it is clear and properly labeled) and the 🤖 BOT arrived: Kick sends its native badge, and the famous robots (Nightbot, StreamElements, Streamlabs, Botrix...) are recognized by name on every network. Its own on/off switch in the badges area, like the others.
📄 LIVE-CHAT DEFAULTS: in both chats (panel and pinned chat), the comment text now comes BELOW the name by default, and the default reading direction is NEWEST ON TOP.

❓ FAQ: new settings page with 20 questions and answers about everything in OBS Social — connections, the overlay in OBS, dot colors, arranging the screen, pieces, art, backup, security, network, updates...
🧹 As a bonus: the data-cleanup card (which had never been translated) now speaks the 10 languages, along with everything else new in this version.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+126 phrases and 5 patterns per dictionary).

0.41.0.titulo: Your art becomes the 🖼️ piece on the map — and Arrange gains ◀▶ undo/redo and ↺ all to default
itens: 🖼️ THE ART NOW ADJUSTS: as soon as you activate an art in "Featured comment background", it appears as the 🖼️ Your art piece inside the Featured card in 🖱️ Arrange the screen AND as a sublayer in 🪟 Layers — drag it, stretch it by the handles, rotate it, change its opacity and pick the Fit (cover/stretch/fit) right from the piece bar. Works WITH OR WITHOUT 🧩 turned on.

📸 DEFAULT UNTOUCHED, PROVEN: with everything at default, the featured card stayed pixel by pixel IDENTICAL to before the big remodel (we compared the captures byte by byte against v0.33.1, with and without art). What changed the look were the "fit"/"The art IS the card" switches being on — now you can see, adjust and undo all of that on the map.

◀▶ UNDO AND REDO FOR EVERYTHING: the Arrange toolbar gained back/forward buttons (and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) covering EVERYTHING the editor touches — each item's position and size, layer order, every piece, the art, pieces mode. Any adjustment, from anywhere, enters the history on its own.
↺ ALL TO DEFAULT: a single button returns the entire Arrange to factory default — positions, sizes, layers, pieces and art. And even that reset can be undone with ◀.
👁 The eye on the 🖼️ Your art sublayer hides/shows the art on the live; in 🧩 mode the art joins the layer stacking like any piece (you can put it above the text, for example).
🌐 FIX: the side-menu items (🔌 Connections, 🎨 Themes, ℹ️ About...) had stopped being translated in the other languages since the menu gained its icons-only mode — they translate again.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.40.0.titulo: Pieces become sublayers in 🪟 Layers — and the preview never misaligns again
itens: 🥞 THE MISSING CONCEPT: in the 🪟 Layers panel, each disassembled item now opens its PIECES as sublayers — the text, the name, the avatar, the clock's time... Drag a sublayer to choose what sits on top of what INSIDE the card/widget (applies on the live), the 👁 truly hides the piece on the live, the 🔒 locks the piece in the editor, and clicking a sublayer selects the piece on the map.

📐 FIX: in full screen, the real preview misaligned from the map when the piece bar opened — the rectangles sat in one place and the actual overlay in another, preventing precise adjustment. Now the preview re-scales itself on ANY map size change.
📏 The piece bar became a single line (scrolling if space runs out) — opening and closing no longer shoves the map around in blocks.
✅ The uploaded-file message told you to click a "Use" button that no longer exists — it now points to the selectors right below, which is where you choose where the media goes.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.39.0.titulo: The 🎨 Themes tab gathers everything, the page uses the whole screen and one 🧩 shatters the overlay
itens: 🎨 REORGANIZATION: everything visual now lives in a single tab — 🎨 THEMES: 🖱️ Arrange the screen (at the top), the widgets, the featured comment, the fixed live chat, your overlays and the themes. They are related, so they live together. The old addresses keep working.
📏 The settings page now uses the FULL WIDTH of the window — the Arrange the screen map got 2 to 3 times bigger without needing full screen (which still exists in ⛶).

🧩 ONE switch: "Overlay in pieces", on the editor toolbar, shatters the ENTIRE overlay at once (featured + every widget). Resizing by the handles needs no button at all — it is always active. The individual switches remain on each one's card, for whoever wants to disassemble just one part.
🍔 The collapsed side menu got truly clean: icons only, centered, with the name in the tooltip.

🔧 GENERAL BUG INSPECTION: (1) a cancelled touch (common on touch screens) left any editor drag stuck, freezing the map until reload — fixed in every drag; (2) each adjustment wrote the whole settings file to disk immediately — one drag generated ~8 writes per second, choking the program mid-chat; now writing waits for the movement to end (the live still reacts instantly, and closing the program saves whatever is pending); (3) the Notices widget no longer accepts "pieces" junk in the settings; (4) colors only enter the overlay stylesheet if they are real colors (#hex); (5) a non-numeric value in a piece could become "NaN%" in the editor.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.38.0.titulo: Everything hands-on: stretch and rotate with the mouse, full-screen editor and collapsible menus
itens: ✋ MAIN NEW THING: 🖱️ Arrange the screen became a direct-manipulation editor. The selected item gains HANDLES on its edges — pull to stretch: the featured card TRULY changes width and height, each disassembled widget's box likewise, and regular items change size. The sliders remain for fine, pixel-by-pixel adjustment; the mouse is the main path.

🔄 Each selected piece also gains a ROTATE handle (⟳ above it) and the width/height/size handles — rotate and stretch any part of the overlay right on the screen, watching the result in the real preview instantly.

⛶ FULL SCREEN: a new button makes the editor take the whole browser window (Esc leaves), with the map fitting the screen height. Open the page in its own tab and the editor becomes a screen of its own — no more wasted space.

📐 The featured and disassembled-widget rectangles now have their REAL SIZE on the map (it used to be a fixed guess) — what you position is exactly what shows on the live. On the map, pieces show only their emoji (the full name appears on the selected one and in the tooltip), so they do not cover the card.
🍔 The settings side menu now collapses to icons only (⏴ button at its top), and the layers panel folds (▾) — more room for the map.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.37.0.titulo: Stages 3 and 4: widgets disassembled into pieces + full fine-tuning and high-res avatar
itens: 🧩 MAIN NEW THING: now the WIDGETS disassemble too. QR Code (code and title), Like-o-meter (numbers, bar and label), Winstreak (icon, label and numbers), Live viewers (total and per network), Clock (time and caption) and Raffle (title and podium) — each widget has the "🧩 Loose pieces" switch (in the Customize widgets card and right on the 🖱️ toolbar when the widget is selected). On, the widget becomes a resizable box and each part of it is dragged on its own, with the live following in real time.

🎛️ EVERY piece (featured and widgets) gained the full FINE-TUNING on the editor bar: 🔄 rotate (-180° to 180°), 🌫️ opacity, 🎨 own color (with a return to the usual color), ✨ shadow, 🪞 mirror and size — plus the on/off and the individual ↺.

🧑 The featured avatar now comes at the HIGHEST resolution each network provides (YouTube 512px, Twitch 300px, Kick full size) — no more blurry photo when the avatar is enlarged. And it gained an adjustable border (thickness and color). The panel lists keep their light photos as always.
🖱️ Grabbing a piece in the editor now also selects its widget — the item bar and the piece bar appear together.
⚙️ Everything with sane limits on the server (no invented value gets in) and touching one piece never erases the others.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.36.0.titulo: Your art now IS the featured card — and the 🧩 right on the editor's face
itens: 🖼️ FEEDBACK FIX: uploading an art as "Featured comment background" seemed to do nothing — it only appeared when a comment was on air, cropped, and underneath the default look (background, bar and shadow remained). Now there is the "The art IS the card" switch: turn it on and the default look disappears entirely — only your art remains, with the content on top of it.
📐 A new selector decides how the art enters the card: COVER (crops the excess, as before), STRETCH (the exact size of the card) or FIT (whole, without cropping or distorting).

🧩 The Loose pieces switch is now also on the 🖱️ Arrange the screen toolbar — turn it on there and the pieces already appear inside the featured card, without hunting for the option in the settings. The complete recipe for your own overlay: 🧩 Loose pieces + Stretch + The art IS the card.
💡 The 🖼️ Your overlays card now explains when the featured background appears (use 🧪 Example to see it instantly) and points to the new switches.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.35.0.titulo: Stage 2 of the editor remodel: 🧩 the featured comment disassembled into loose pieces
itens: 🧩 MAIN NEW THING: the 💬 Featured comment gained LOOSE PIECES mode. Turn it on in the settings and the avatar, the network icon, the name, the badges, the Super Chat amount and the text become 6 independent pieces — each with its own position, size and on/off, draggable in 🖱️ Arrange the screen over the real preview. Made to fit the comment into YOUR art without compromising it.

📏 The name and the text have their own box (adjustable width and height) and a DYNAMIC FIT that decides what happens when the comment does not fit: shrink the letters until it fits (default), cut at the edge, or let it overflow — and in every case the card clips whatever tries to leave it, so NOTHING leaks over your art, not a long name, not a wall of text.

🖱️ Clicking the featured card in the editor shows the pieces inside it; grabbing a piece opens the fine-tuning bar (size, box width/height, fit and the piece's ↺). Dragging reflects ON THE LIVE in real time.
📐 The card height in free mode is adjustable (in multiples of the letter size, to follow the font).
🧰 Turned off, the card assembles itself again as always — nothing changes for whoever does not use the mode.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.34.0.titulo: Stage 1 of the editor remodel: 🪟 layers and 📺 real preview in Arrange the screen
itens: 🪟 MAIN NEW THING: 🖱️ Arrange the screen gained a LAYERS panel, like in Photoshop. Each piece of the screen (your frame/overlay, the featured comment and each widget) is a layer — drag in the list to choose what sits on top of what, and the order truly applies ON THE LIVE. Now you can put your frame ON TOP of the featured comment, the clock underneath it, and so on. The ↺ returns the usual order.

👁 Each layer has an eye to hide it ONLY in the editor (to work calmly over your art — nothing is turned off on the live) and a 🔒 to lock it, avoiding bumping a piece already in place. The eye and lock choices stay in your browser.

📺 The editor now shows a REAL PREVIEW: the actual /overlay, at the real size of the chosen screen, shrunk to fit the canvas — what you see is exactly what OBS captures, with your frame, the widgets and the real fonts. The colored rectangles became outlines over the preview (and you can turn the preview off if you prefer the old mode).
🧪 A new button puts a sample comment on air so you can see the featured comment in the editor while adjusting — it appears in OBS too, and the same button takes it off.
🧰 This is the first step of the editor's big remodel (overlay pieces adjustable independently). The next stages come in separate versions.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages.

0.33.1.titulo: Badge switches now apply to the pinned chat instantly
itens: 🏷️ FIX: in the 💬 Fixed live chat, turning a badge on or off in the settings only applied to comments arriving AFTERWARDS — the ones already on screen kept the old look until they scrolled away. Now the pinned chat redraws the badges instantly, just like the panel and the featured comment.
✔️ Applies to every switch on the 🏷️ Chat badges page: each role, the platform's original art, the "other badges" and the master switch.

0.33.0.titulo: The real badges from the 3 platforms — and what moderation deletes leaves the screen
itens: 🏷️ MAIN NEW THING: OBS Social now fetches the ORIGINAL badges from YouTube, Twitch and Kick and shows each one's art next to the colored label. The channel's artwork for member levels, Twitch's own badges (Prime, Turbo, bits, gifts, events, channel-exclusive art) and Kick's appear on screen just like on the site — all without login and without an API key.

🎖️ Every role the three APIs send is in: owner, moderator, VIP, subscriber (with tier), member, founder, OG and verified account. And the ones without a fixed role (each channel has its own) appear too, with the platform's art or, when there is no art, an outline in the network's color.

🎚️ A new settings page — 🏷️ Chat badges — lets you TURN EACH ONE OFF SEPARATELY, with a preview of how it looks on screen. You can also drop just the images and keep the program's colored labels, or turn them all off at once. Applies to the live (overlays) and the panel at the same time.

🗑️ When a moderator deletes a comment, bans or times someone out, or clears the chat, the comment now DISAPPEARS INSTANTLY from the panel, the pinned chat and the featured spot on the live — the same way it disappears on the platform's site. It used to remain on the live screen after being removed from chat. Works on YouTube, Twitch and Kick, and can be turned off in the settings.
✔️ Kick badges that came with a raw name now appear properly, and the channel's subscriber artwork (1 month, 3 months, 6 months...) is used when Kick sends it.
🌐 All of it translated into the 10 languages, including the badge previews.

0.32.0.titulo: The Kick column (and any quiet network's) is never empty again
itens: 📋 MAIN FIX: the program kept ONE list of 300 comments for all networks together. In a live with YouTube going wild, Kick's comments were pushed out of that list and its column looked almost empty — even with the counter showing the right total. Now each network has its own space of 300, so a quiet network's column is never again suffocated by the others' volume.

🕘 Kick now brings back MUCH more history. Its site delivers 25 comments at a time plus a marker to continue further back — the program only read the first batch. Now it follows that marker and recovers up to 200 at once.
💬 Kick chat replies (when someone answers someone else) were being dropped from the history. They are back.
🔄 Each column's 🔄 button now also returns to the panel what the server had already stored — before, if the panel had lost old comments, not even the button brought them back.
✔️ Kick's verified-channel badge showed as the raw word "verified"; now it becomes the panel's proper badge.
⚡ Lighter Kick reconnection: the full fetch only happens the first time (or when you press 🔄); automatic reconnections fetch only the recent past, and never two fetches at the same time.

0.31.0.titulo: Correct counters in every tab and 👤 unique people per column
itens: 🔢 FIX: the "Live" tab's number sat well below the real total — it only counted what had passed through the panel's screen, not the whole live. If you opened or refreshed the panel mid-live, the count restarted from almost zero. Now every tab shows the day's real number, counted by the server.
💰 The same applied to Super Chats, Members and Donations: all three now count the entire live. And a donation is no longer counted twice (as a donation and as a super chat).
♾️ No counter has a ceiling. The raffle badge also stopped stopping at "99+" and shows the real number.
📜 On restart, the counters now read the whole day's file. Before, only the last 5 MB counted, and in a big live the total came back smaller than it was.
👤 Each column gained a third counter: how many DIFFERENT people have spoken in it. In Unified, the sum of all networks.
🎁 The raffle button now shows, besides the participants, the total tickets in play — a glance tells you whether the levels (sub, member, founder, Tier 2, Tier 3...) are being counted.

0.30.0.titulo: Scrolling that never jams again, chat history back and 🔄 on every column
itens: 🖱️ FIX: with many people talking, chat scrolling jammed — the mouse wheel would not catch and the scrollbar slipped out of your hand. The panel rebuilt the entire list on every message, dozens of times per second, and the browser cancelled your drag midway. Now messages are batched and, while you are scrolling, nothing is rebuilt: the panel waits for you to let go.

🕘 FIX: when a chat's connection dropped and returned (which happens on its own during a live), the program did ask for the lost comments back — but threw them ALL away by mistake. Kick, Twitch and Bilibili had this problem. Now the gap truly closes.
🔄 Each column gained a button to reload just itself: it restarts that network and fetches back the comments the platform still keeps. In Unified, the button reloads all of them at once.
⏱️ And you can make it automatic: in ⚙️ Settings → Customize the panel, choose how often the chats reload on their own — from "never" (button only) up to 60 minutes.
👀 A connected network's column now appears even before its first message — before, a silent network had no column and you could not reload it.
🔌 Also fixed: an old connection dropping later could open a second parallel connection to the same network.

0.29.1.titulo: Security inspection: three crashes and one hole fixed
itens: 🛡️ The program closed on its own in three situations — a mistyped address in the browser (like "localhost:3000/%"), a strange command from another machine on the network, and any hiccup in a tab's connection. Now none of that takes the live down: the error stays in that tab or that request.

🔐 The lock against malicious sites had a hole: an outside site pointing its own name at your network's IP could pass as local and open the panel. Fixed — now the address must really belong to your machine or your network.
🎵 Sound and images can only come from OBS Social's own folders. Before, whoever had settings permission on the network could make the panel and the live load files from any site.
📎 File uploads now accept only image, video and audio.
🧱 A cap of 30 on additional QR codes and winstreaks, and a size limit on panel messages — before, you could fill memory and disk by repeating "add more".
🔎 Also hardened: old sessions are cleaned up, the updater refuses to leave https, and channel names go sanitized into Twitch chat.

0.29.0.titulo: Blinking your way and the raffle die with sound
itens: ⏳ The timer's final stretch is now yours: on/off, starting however many seconds from the end you want (1 to 60) and in the color you pick.
🔴 The 00:00 blink too: on/off, the color is yours and it can stop on its own after a few seconds (or blink forever, as before).

📢 The Notice gained the same three controls, with its own timing — it can start blinking well before the number, if you want — and a color of its own while blinking (or none, keeping the text's normal color).
🎲 In the raffle, you can choose how long the die spins on screen before the podium (0 to 15 seconds; 0 goes straight to the winners). The default remains 2.2 seconds.
🔊 The die gained sound, like the timer: a file of your choice, volume from 0 to 100 and where it plays (panel, live or both). It ships with a ready die sound.
🌐 As a bonus, the entire 🕐 Clock and 🎁 Raffle cards were translated into the 10 languages, including the time-zone list — they used to appear only in Portuguese.

0.28.0.titulo: Winstreak back in place, standardized animations and text format
itens: 🏆 FIX: in v0.26.0 the winstreak card became a stripe stretched across the entire screen width, with sparks scattered everywhere. It was one extra CSS line pulling the card out of its corner. It is back at the right size, in the chosen corner, and the sparks now rise inside the card.

🎬 Every animation in every selector: entry and exit now offer exactly the same 11 effects (appear, slide from all 4 sides, hop, zoom, bounce, 3D flip, spin and blur) on the featured comment, the widgets and the fixed live chat.
🔁 The loop animations also became complete and equal in all three places, with 4 new ones: bounce, endless spin, blur-and-return and shake.
📄 The fixed live chat gained the option to show the text below the name, just like the live panel.
📄 And the live panel gained the opposite option: show the text next to the name, just like the fixed live chat, with the time on the right.
🌐 In the fixed live chat, commenters' text is now protected from the language translator — a short phrase could end up translated by accident.

0.27.0.titulo: A timer sound that actually plays, final countdown and the "not secure" explanation
itens: 🔊 The timer's end sound did not play in several browsers (Edge, and the phone and tablet ones): they only release audio after a tap on the page. Now OBS Social prepares the sound on its own and, if the browser still holds it, shows a "click here to enable the sound" invitation that fixes it with one click. Inside OBS nothing changes — the sound already played there.
⏳ Final stretch: in the last 10 seconds, the timer digits turn yellow and pulse — on the panel and on the live screen.
📢 The Notice blinks softly again in those final 10 seconds. It did not blink because the animation fought the frame's own entry animation; now the blink goes on the text and the two coexist.
🔴 The red 00:00 blink got much calmer (from 0.7s to 1.8s), no scare, and the color never fully disappears.
⏱️ The stopwatch shows tenths of a second (00:05.4) on the live screen too, with an option to turn it off in 🧩 Customize widgets.

🔐 A new explanation in 🔗 URLs for OBS about the "your connection to this site is not secure" notice: why it appears, why it is not a problem with your computer or your network, and why a homemade certificate would be worse (and would set the antivirus off).

0.26.0.titulo: Three-level winstreak milestones and the clock on the strip
itens: 🕐 The clock moved to the center of the tools strip, in the free space — right in the middle, as requested
✨ Winstreak milestones now appear ON THE LIVE SCREEN too (before, panel only) and the effect STAYS while the number sits on the milestone, leaving on its own when it passes

🥇 Three celebration levels: tens (10, 20, 30...) with a golden glow; big milestones (50, 100, 200, 300...) with a strong glow and rising sparks; and the doublings (10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 320...) with colored sparks, a halo on the whole card and pulsing — the most special effect of all
🎯 When a number serves more than one level (like 20 and 80), the most special one always wins

0.25.3.titulo: Timer options on the panel and the Notice blinking at the end
itens: ⌛ The timer-end options now live in the clock's own panel (in Timer mode): take the Notice off the screen, blink the number at zero, blink the Notice at the end and where the sound plays — no need to open the settings
📢 In the timer's final 10 seconds, the on-screen Notice blinks softly so the audience notices time is running out (can be turned off)
🔁 The same options remain in the settings, and the two screens stay in sync

0.25.2.titulo: Clock in the header and the organizer fixed
itens: 🐞 Fixed: the panel organizer could not move the Clipboard, the Notices and the Clock — the program discarded the order on save when it contained new items. Now all of them can be dragged freely
🕐 The clock left the button row and became a display in the center of the header, in the free space next to the program's name — clicking it opens the same clock, stopwatch and timer menu
📅 New option: show only the time, or time + date, on the panel display
⏱️ While the stopwatch or the timer is running, the display shows the time elapsed (with the label below) and returns to the clock when it ends

0.25.1.titulo: Timer sound on the live and a default alert included
itens: 📺 The timer sound can now play on the live too: a new selector with "on the panel and the live", "live only" (the audience hears it) or "only on my computer"
⏰ OBS Social now ships with a ready timer alert sound — nothing to upload to start using it (and you can swap in your own whenever you like)
🎧 Uploaded audio files are now served with the right type (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, AAC, FLAC, Opus), which some needed in order to play

0.25.0.titulo: 📢 Notices, 🕐 Clock and a beefed-up Winstreak
itens: 🏆 Winstreak: now has + and − for the RECORD too (so you can fix an accidental add) — and the record never drops below the current wins
⏩ Hold any + or − button and it adds faster and faster, in bigger steps (the ×5, ×10 shows beside it)
⌨️ The 0/0 numbers became fields: click and type the wins and the record directly
✨ When the record hits a round number (5, 10, 25, 50, 100...), the number glows golden to celebrate

📢 New Notices overlay: write a message of up to 1000 characters and put it on screen — with font, size, colors, alignment, bold/italic/underline, uppercase, shadow and all the animations, like the other overlays
🕐 New Clock overlay: the panel button shows the current time and, on click, lets you pick 🕐 Clock (with date), ⏱️ Stopwatch or ⏳ Timer — any of them goes to the live screen
🌍 Time zone in the settings: "the computer's" or any zone in the world (GMT/UTC, Brasília, Lisbon, Tokyo...) — the on-screen clock uses the chosen one
🤝 Timer + Notices working together: when time runs out, the notice leaves the screen on its own (you can turn this partnership off)
🔊 For the first time OBS Social plays a sound: pick an audio file (any format, up to 20 seconds) to announce the timer hitting zero, with volume from 0 to 100

🎨 New Themes page (was "Panel"): customize OBS Social completely — colors for everything (accent, background, cards, inner boxes, text, soft text and borders), the program's background image, font, text and icon sizes, rounded corners and spacing
✨ 10 ready themes to load at once: Default, Deep purple, Ocean, Forest, Ember, Neon pink, Soft light, Paper, High contrast and Retro — then just adjust whatever you like on top
💾 Save your theme to a file and load it on another computer (or share it with other streamers)
⚡ Everything changes instantly, on the panel and in the settings at the same time, with no reload
🔍 The "Interface size" stays where it was and keeps working — it enlarges everything at once and is independent of the theme

0.23.0.titulo: Cleanup center and dialogs with OBS Social's face
itens: 💬 Goodbye browser popups: every notice and confirmation is now an OBS Social window — with your colors, icons, keyboard (Enter confirms, Esc cancels) and translated into the 10 languages

🧹 New cleanup center in Settings → 🗄️ Logs and data: one button for each kind of data (logs, uploaded media, read marks and queue, raffle participants, saved channels, QR codes and winstreaks), each showing how much it occupies and telling exactly what it deletes

💣 "Delete everything and return to factory default" has its own red, more serious alert: it lists item by item what will be deleted and only unlocks the button after you type DELETE. Your network access password is kept, so you are not locked out
📺 Fixed the Bilibili leftover: when navigating between settings pages, its card reappeared in Connections even when off in Labs — now it truly disappears
🔢 The cleanup numbers refresh on their own when the tab opens (they used to freeze at whatever existed when the page was opened)

0.22.2.titulo: Avatars back and no more version mixing
itens: 📸 Fixed the v0.22.1 damage: YouTube avatars vanishing, the panel flashing and the enlarge coming up empty — the bigger-photo attempt now has a guaranteed way back: if the image server refuses the large size, the avatar returns to the original address instantly (and only as a last resort becomes the colored initial); the enlarge is never empty again

🧊 Found and fixed an old problem: the program sent no cache instructions to the browser — after an update, the browser and OBS could mix new files with old ones (causing exactly these strange behaviors). Now every file is checked with the server on each load, with no speed loss
⏱️ The live-time clock became surgical: it updates only the ⏱ text, redrawing nothing else every second

0.22.1.titulo: Live fixes: Twitch, Kick and sharp avatars
itens: 🟣 Twitch's ⏱ did not appear: Twitch changed its public query code (Client-ID) and the query returned error 400 — now OBS Social reads the current code from Twitch's own page and, if it changes again, rediscovers it by itself

🟢 Kick blocked by Cloudflare (error 403): the program now insists on its own with growing waits (30s, 60s... up to 5min) — no need to click reconnect mid-live; Kick's audience queries were also spaced out (30s) to avoid provoking the block
⏱️ The live time now shows seconds and ticks second by second (2h13m05s), with the data checked every 10s

📸 YouTube avatars in high resolution: the chat sends tiny photos (32px) — we now request 256px for the feed and, in the enlarged avatar (right click), the photo comes at 512px on YouTube and 600px on Twitch
🛟 A passing query failure no longer erases the chip's last known state (no more 💤 flashing for nothing)

0.22.0.titulo: Timestamps settled, Kick recovering and live time
itens: 🕐 Found and fixed the rest of the timestamp bug: on restart, memory came back in the log's ARRIVAL order (history recovered late sat out of place) — now it always returns sorted by real time
🔢 Same-second messages gained a stable tiebreaker (arrival number): the order never varies between refreshes again, in the panel, the columns and the pinned chat
🟢 Fixed Kick message recovery: the history endpoint requires the channel's numeric ID (with the name it silently answered 404); YouTube, Twitch and Bilibili were checked and keep recovering
⏱️ Live time on the panel chips: each connected network shows how long its live has been on air (⏱ 2h13), straight from the platform itself

💤 Real-time online monitor: if the platform says the live left the air, the chip dims with 💤 (the chat stays connected) — YouTube, Twitch, Kick and Bilibili, refreshed every 10 seconds along with the audience

🌍 Eight new languages, chosen by the most used on live platforms: Spanish, French, German, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (simplified) — all complete, with the terms each streaming community actually uses
⚡ Each page downloads only the dictionary of the language in use (no extra weight on OBS); the 🌐 Language tab's selector reorders itself alphabetically in the current language

📣 Feedback with a Subject selector: General feedback, Problem or error, Idea or suggestion, Help with connections, Help with OBS and the overlays, Update and installation, Languages and translations, Praise or thanks — and ✉️ Other, which opens a box for you to write any subject you want

📬 The chosen subject goes straight into the e-mail's subject field; the categories always stay in Portuguese in the e-mail (even with the interface in another language), so the developer can organize everything in one place
🌐 New Language tab in the settings: "System language" (follows the browser/computer of whoever opens each page) or a fixed language for everyone
🇺🇸 Complete English: panel, settings, overlays, pinned chat, notices, connection status and confirmation dialogs — translated with the right streaming terms (Queue, Featured, Giveaway, Winstreak...)
⚡ The switch applies instantly, on every open page — no restart and no reload, even mid-live
🔒 What you or the viewers write (messages, names, widget titles) is never translated; whatever lacks a translation appears in Portuguese
🧱 Foundation ready for new languages: each future language is just a dictionary file
📺 Since Bilibili is experimental (no login, it may shorten names or refuse to connect), it now has an activation switch in 🧪 Labs — off by default
🔌 With the switch off, its card disappears from Connections, test messages skip its sample and connection attempts are refused with a notice
♻️ Whoever already used Bilibili loses nothing: on update, the switch turns itself on for whoever had a saved channel
🧹 Turning the switch off drops the connection and forgets the saved channel
✂️ The panel's ⏱️ and 🌊 selectors had clipped text ("Real time (minimum of the netw...") — the labels got short and clean; the full explanation remains in the hover tooltip

🕐 Fixed: timestamps could fall out of order in the columns, the unified feed and the pinned chat — it happened when recovered history arrived AFTER live messages (e.g. on a reconnection) and landed at the end of the list
📅 Now every message enters at its real time's position: the timeline stays correct in the panel, the pinned chat and the server's memory
🧹 The "Open Arrange the screen" button left Your overlays — no longer needed: the map is right above, on the same page

0.18.0.titulo: Screen & widgets: everything in one place
itens: 🖥️ New Screen & widgets page in the settings: 🖱️ Arrange the screen left the panel and now lives there, full page — together with Customize widgets and Your overlays, all in one place, without distortion
🖱️ The panel button stays where it was, but became a shortcut: click it and the Screen & widgets page opens directly
🔗 Old shortcuts and links (Your overlays) automatically lead to the new page

🖼️ Fixed: each person's FIRST message on Twitch stayed photo-less forever (the avatar lookup finished after the message and never came back to fill it in) — now, when the photo arrives, all of that person's older messages get the avatar instantly, in the panel and the pinned chat, without flashing
🟢 Kick: avatars are now fetched from the site's public API (before, nobody on Kick had a photo)
📺 Bilibili: likewise, via the public profile API (when it allows)
♻️ The fix also applies to the featured comment, the raffle and whoever opens the panel later
📺 New selector in URLs for OBS: normal, horizontal, vertical (9:16, for phone lives) or both overlays together
🔗 With both, everything is linked automatically: set up a widget, winstreak or color and it appears on both overlays — no rework

📱 Only the POSITIONS are independent: 🖱️ Arrange the screen gains the 🖥️ Horizontal and 📱 Vertical tabs (the map stands upright in vertical), and each screen keeps its own arrangement — including additional QRs and winstreaks
🌐 The vertical live uses its own URL (overlay?tela=vertical), which appears on the URLs page when the mode includes vertical

0.16.0.titulo: Enlarged avatar with the right button
itens: 🔍 Right-click any avatar on the panel: the photo enlarges instantly, on the panel AND on the OBS screen — perfect for highlighting who commented
🎚️ A slider enlarges or shrinks the image (the size applies in both places and is remembered)
🎨 Whoever has no photo appears as the colored initial circle, enlarged the same way
✖ Closes via the panel button, clicking outside, or together with Clear the screen
📌 Scrolled up to read older comments? The list NO LONGER jumps back when new messages arrive — the message you were reading stays exactly where it was (applies to the columns and the unified mode)
▶️ Whoever is at the edge of the new messages keeps following the flow normally, as always
🖱️ Click a column's header to jump straight back to the new messages — to the bottom, or to the top if your direction is inverted — and to page 1

0.15.0.titulo: Role badges with highlights and colors
itens: 🏷️ The badges gained highlights with each role's classic colors: 👑 OWNER (red), 🛡️ MOD (green), 💎 VIP (pink), ⭐ SUB (Twitch purple — or Kick green), 🎖️ MEMBER (YouTube green), 🏆 FOUNDER and 🏅 OG (Kick)
🖱️ The label is short to avoid clutter; the full name appears on hover — including the sub tier (T2, T3, Prime) and the YouTube member level
🖥️ Applies on the panel, the pinned chat and the featured comment; Super Chats and donations keep their message's own color
💬 The test messages now include examples with MOD, SUB T3 and VIP so you can see the badges
🔢 The little queue number moved from 🔃 to ⏭️ Skip ahead — where it makes more sense: that is exactly what it flushes
