➕ And the number now sums everything: the unified smooth-flow queue + each column's queue

0.14.1.titulo: Individual smooth flow in the columns and the 🔃 balloon fixed
itens: 🕊️ Each network's column got its smooth flow with ⏳ held messages back — but now each has its OWN queue, dripping at its own pace (automatic by default): a YouTube burst never delays Twitch
🌊 The Per-column mode remains for whoever wants the exact rhythm of each one (0.5s to 5s)
🔧 The little number on the 🔃 button appeared out of place and only on hover — now it stays anchored to the button's corner, visible whenever there is a queue
🧱 New "Per column" mode in the 🌊 selector: each column gets its own rhythm selector in the footer (instant, or 0.5s to 5s between messages) — one column never waits for another
💬 In per-column mode, the Unified column's selector controls the pace of the smooth flow itself
⏳ With its own rhythm, each column again shows how many messages await their turn

⏭️ New button next to 🔃: flushes the WHOLE queue at once, without waiting for the rhythm — for whoever wants to jump straight to the current messages (applies to the unified feed, the pinned chat and each column's queue)
⚡ Each network's column now shows messages THE MOMENT they arrive — without waiting for the smooth-flow queue (which used to make the small network wait for the big network's flush)
🕊️ The smooth flow (⏱️/🌊/🔃) now applies only to the unified feed: unified mode, the 💬 Unified column and the screen's pinned chat
⏳ The held-messages counter stays only on the unified column — the network columns have nothing left to wait for
ℹ️ The little number on the 🔃 button (top right corner) is exactly that: how many messages await the unified feed's smooth flow

0.13.0.titulo: Columns without limits, with pagination and message recovery
itens: 🔢 Each column's counter now shows that network's REAL total for the live (counted on the server), not just what fits on screen — and the Live tab's memory holds the entire live
📄 Pagination in every column: no infinite scrolling — 20 messages per page by default, adjustable from 5 to 100 in the 📄 selector next to the filters
⏳ Each column shows how many messages are held in the smooth-flow queue, waiting to enter

🕘 Lost-message recovery: if the live dropped or the program was closed, on reconnect OBS Social pulls whatever each service offers of the recent chat — YouTube (last dozens), Twitch (via the community recent-messages service), Kick (recents from the site API) and Bilibili (last ~10) — without duplicating anything; can be turned off in 🧪 Labs
⠿ Drag any column by its header to move it freely, right on the panel — including the 💬 Unified column
💾 The chosen order is saved and survives closing and reopening the program
🖐️ During the drag the panel holds chat updates, so the column does not slip out of your hand — and releases everything as soon as you let go

0.11.0.titulo: Chats in columns on the Live tab
itens: 🧱 New Columns mode on the Live tab: each network (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Bilibili and Donations) gets its own column, side by side, each with a message counter
💬 Extra option + Unified: also shows the shared chat column (all networks together) next to the separate columns
🎛️ The network filters become column controls: turn a network off and its column disappears
🔎 Search keeps working: while you search, the panel returns to unified mode and, when you clear it, the columns come back
🕊️ The smooth flow and the message entry effect work the same inside the columns

0.10.1.titulo: Space between messages and an entry effect
itens: 🌊 New panel selector: spacing between each message as it appears (0.5 to 5 seconds, or automatic) — for a very calm, ticker-like flow, even in giant lives
✨ Each new message enters with a soft slide-and-focus effect, tailor-made for that kind of flow
🔢 The 🔃 button's counter now also tracks the messages leaving the queue, one by one
🕊️ Messages now enter the panel and the pinned chat at a steady, peaceful pace — even in giant lives, no more bursts dumped at once
⏱️ A rhythm selector on the panel itself: real time (default), every 2 to 60 seconds, or 🖐️ manual — in manual nothing enters on its own
🔃 A manual refresh button (in any mode) with a counter of waiting messages — and on release, they also enter smoothly
🔎 Search and the logs keep receiving everything instantly, whatever rhythm you choose

0.9.4.titulo: Audience in the right place and a hunt for misalignments
itens: 👥 In the audience's total mode, the numbers' side now truly applies relative to the LOGOS (right, left, above and below) — the number used to sit always on top
🙅 New selector to remove the people icon 👥 from the audience widget (in the panel popover and the widget editor)
🎚️ Filter selectors no longer crush the network names, the screen size got its own label (Screen) separate from Grid, and two-column fields stay aligned even with different text lengths
🛡️ Full code audit: access gates, updater, screens and history — no exploitable vulnerability found

🔧 Three preventive hardenings: update packages with backslashes no longer dodge the checks on Windows, the panel-organizer fields are sanitized on the server, and the brute-force lock clears its memory of old IPs

🛡️ The restart no longer force-closes the old window — antivirus software (like Kaspersky) treated that as malware behavior and blocked the program. If the old window asks you to "press any key", just close it one last time: with the new start script, restarts reuse the same window
🔄 The updater now points straight at the repository's current name (OBSSocial)

0.9.1.titulo: Sliders in the right design and commands that never get lost
itens: 🎚️ Redesigned sliders: a thin line with a big knob, matching the overlay controls, and neatly aligned with the text

📨 Commands clicked during a reconnection (e.g. right after updating) are no longer lost — they wait in a queue and are sent as soon as the program answers (fixes Restrict the network sometimes not showing the password and the switches)
⚡ Restrict the network now responds on screen instantly, without waiting for the server

0.9.0.titulo: The panel your way, a window that does not pile up and screen-size preview
itens: 🧲 Fully customizable panel: drag the tool icons and the tabs into any order (Settings → Panel, with a real-time preview) and choose whether the bar sits above or below the tabs
🪟 Restart and update now REUSE the same black window — no more piling windows (and the old window no longer keeps asking to "press any key")
🖥️ Pick any screen size in Arrange the screen (Full HD, 2K, 4K, ultrawide, vertical or custom) to see how the overlays look — positions are in % and adapt on their own
📱 The panel and the settings adjust to smaller screens (bars wrap instead of overflowing)

0.8.0.titulo: Network permissions switch by switch, restart in Connections and more
itens: 🔒 Restricted mode revamped: you now choose EXACTLY what the network may use, with a slider for each thing — clipboard, search, comments on screen, connections, tools, settings, media and logs
🎚️ Every on/off in the program became a pretty slider switch (Labs, raffle, filters, update...)
♻️ New button in Connections to restart OBS Social on the spot (closes and reopens by itself)
🔍 The update check now runs at program startup too (and still 1x a day; still optional and never installs on its own)
📜 The changelog gained pages: 5 versions at a time, with arrows to navigate
🧹 Options that no longer made sense were removed from the About page

0.7.1.titulo: Visuals: a real eye, full boxes and centered QRs
itens: 👁 The little monkey 🙈 became a drawn eye that opens and closes on show/hide — on the URLs and the panel's show/remove buttons
📏 The URL boxes keep their large size even when hidden
💖 The support QR codes are now centered and aligned

🔁 The program now looks for updates on its own once a day and announces on the panel when a new version exists — with a switch to turn it off (and it NEVER installs anything without your confirmation)
♻️ On clicking Update, OBS Social installs, closes and reopens by itself — the panel reloads and the overlay in OBS reconnects with you doing nothing
🛟 The start scripts are no longer replaced while the program is open (extra protection on Windows) and the port is reopened patiently on rebirth
Security update and internal maintenance.
🔧 The updater gained extra download paths and clearer error messages

0.5.6.titulo: Clearer error messages in the update
itens: 🩺 When the update package is not reachable, the message explains better what happened

0.5.5.titulo: Updates work even with an antivirus intercepting the internet
itens: 🛡️ The update downloader now also trusts Windows certificates — solves the SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN error caused by antivirus/firewalls with "HTTPS inspection" (connection security stays on, always)
🩺 If Node.js is too old for that, the error message explains the solution (update Node or disable the antivirus HTTPS inspection)
🔄 The update button now tries several paths until it succeeds: a new downloader more tolerant of troubled networks, forced IPv4 as plan B and GitHub's alternate address as plan C
🩺 If it still fails, the error message shows the exact technical cause to make support easier

0.5.3.titulo: Support: NuBank with a new link and PicPay removed
itens: 🟣 The NuBank QR and link were replaced with the new payment link
🟢 The PicPay card was removed — NuBank (Pix from any bank), LivePix and PixGG remain

0.5.2.titulo: Credits with the creator's full name
itens: ℹ️ The About page now credits Wanderson de Souza Ferreira (Ward'z de Souza) with the full name
💖 The Support the Developer page now ships with the official QR codes for NuBank, PicPay (Pix copy-and-paste), LivePix and PixGG
🔗 Each card gained buttons to open the direct link and to copy (the Pix copy-and-paste code works in any bank's app)

0.5.0.titulo: Feedback, Support the Developer, About and 1-click updates
itens: 📣 New Feedback page: write your suggestion or problem and send it by e-mail right from the settings
💖 New Support the Developer page: NuBank, PicPay, LivePix and PixGG QR codes to support the project
ℹ️ New About page: app information, creator credits and this changelog you are reading
🔄 1-click update (OTA): check and install the new version without going to GitHub — you decide whether to update, and your settings, password, logs and media stay intact

0.4.0.titulo: Simpler local network and a monitor of connected machines
itens: 🌐 Remote access removed entirely: only your network/Wi-Fi gets in — outside connections are always refused
🔗 The access options moved to the URLs for OBS page: the panel address for other people, an optional password and restricted mode (default) or full freedom
🖥️ Machines connected now: watch live who is accessing the panel — machine name (when the network reports it), device/browser, IP and open tabs (only your computer sees this)
🔑 Optional password for whoever accesses over the network (stored only as a scrambled code, never in plain text)
🙈 All the settings URLs stay hidden until you click the eye 🙈/👁
🛡️ Restricted mode by default for the password-less network and a lock against repeated password attempts

0.2.0.titulo: Raffle by level, independent extras and much more
itens: 🎟️ Raffle tickets by level: Twitch Prime/Tier 1-3, Kick sub and founder and YouTube member levels (including named ones) — all without login, via the chat's public badges; with a switch for an open raffle
📱🏆 Additional QR codes and winstreaks 100% independent: they coexist on screen, each with its own colors, size, position and animations
🔎 Global comment search: finds any message, even across hundreds of pages, sweeping the on-disk logs too
🎬 Exit animations and 🔁 loops (blink, glow, breathe, float, sway...), all with adjustable speed, and screen time for every overlay
👥 Live audience with dynamic ordering, numbers on the side you choose and a widget for the public
🔄 Buttons to restart connections, connection memory with automatic reconnection and ✓ read marking with time
🖱️ Arrange the screen with a grid (fixed or free), per-item size and a draggable full-screen media
💬 YouTube, Twitch, Kick and Bilibili chats together in a single panel, without login and without an API key
🖱️ Click a comment and it appears on the live screen (OBS Browser Source), in the color of the writer's network
💰 Super Chats with their real color and currency conversion to reais, 👑 a Members tab and 💝 Donations
🎨 Customizable overlays: position, colors, fonts, your own background media and custom CSS
📱 QR Code, 🎁 Raffle, 📊 Like-o-meter, 🏆 Winstreak and 📋 shared Clipboard

0.45.0.titulo: The raffle with suspense on the panel, comments that never re-blink, the changelog in 10 languages and the upright panel
itens: 🎁 THE PANEL RAFFLE IS THE SAME AS THE SCREEN'S: the podium that opens on the panel now rolls the SAME die 🎲 as the audience's, with the same timing (the raffle's selector), the same reveal order and the same widget layout — the streamer feels the suspense along. And the ✖ Remove the podium from the screen button (the same as the 🎁 tool's) is right there in the modal.

🫧 COMMENTS NO LONGER RE-BLINK: when a column updates, each comment keeps ITS place on screen — only what arrives is born (with the arrival animation), only what leaves dies, and avatars stop reloading. Less annoying for everyone, and especially for people sensitive to motion.

🫧 THE ARRIVAL IS YOURS: in 🎨 Themes, in the Panel part, choose the comments' arrival animation (slide, fade, pop, zoom, bounce or none) and the duration (0.1s to 2s). Applies to the Live tab and the columns.
📱↕ UPRIGHT MONITOR: the panel now adjusts to vertical screens of any size — in columns mode they wrap into stacked rows (scrolling down) instead of squeezing or turning into sideways scrolling.

💣 DELETE EVERYTHING NOW REBOOTS PROPERLY: Delete everything now RESTARTS the program on its own through the SAME path as the update and the ♻️ button (no tricks that annoy antivirus software) — the screens announce it and reload when it comes back.

🌐 THE CHANGELOG SPEAKS 10 LANGUAGES: this entire version history (72 versions!) now appears in the interface language — each language has its complete mirror, and whatever is missing shows in Portuguese.

🧭 REFERENCES UP TO DATE: the Timer and other corners cited the "🖥️ Screen & widgets" page, which became the 🎨 Themes tab — every text points to the right place. And the clock's long-form date now follows the interface language.
🌐 Everything translated into the 10 languages (+42 phrases and 1 pattern per dictionary), including old leftovers from the clock popover (Timer, sounds, winstreak).

0.52.1.titulo: Free placement on the Board, collapsible lists and a panel your way
itens: 🎛️ Board buttons go WHEREVER YOU WANT: leave empty spaces on purpose, drag a key into any gap, and dropping it on another key swaps the two. The ➕ creates the button in that exact space.
📦 Uploaded media became collapsible lists (like the changelog), with the count in the header — no more half a screen taken up. Open/closed is remembered in your browser.
↩️ A button name takes as many line breaks as you like (the only limit is still 50 letters), and the field grows on its own as you type.

📐 Where you left each little window and card in the panel is YOURS: position and size come back the same after a reload, a restart or closing the program — like the theme and the language. Changed monitors? Nothing gets lost off-screen.
📊 The like meter percentage moved to the MIDDLE and got the spotlight on the audience screen; in the panel it sits in the middle too, between the two numbers.

💜 The 💖 Support the Developer page now clearly separates one-off donations from the new monthly support "Friends of OBS Social" — with a divider, a label on each block and a note that no feature depends on it: everything stays free.

0.52.2.titulo: Free placement reaches every button grid
itens: 🎛️ Free placement now works in EVERY button grid: the one inside the folder editor drags too — empty spaces, swapping with another key, and dropping on ⬅ takes the key out of the folder.

0.52.3.titulo: OBS can be on any computer on the network
itens: 🎬 FIX: the OBS connection was stuck on this computer (127.0.0.1) — only port and password existed. There is now an Address field: leave 127.0.0.1 for OBS on the same machine, or enter its IP for OBS on another computer on the network.
🧹 The address accepts whatever you paste without thinking: ws://192.168.0.10:4455, 192.168.0.10:4455 or with spaces all become the same IP. Machine names and IPv6 work too.

💬 When it doesn’t connect, the message now says WHAT it tried and where to look: it names the address and port, and for network cases it reminds you about that machine’s firewall and the WebSocket server that must be on in the OBS over there.

0.53.0.titulo: All of OBS becomes a button
itens: 🎬 The panel’s 🎬 tool became a COMPLETE OBS control: stream, record (with pause and chapter marker), virtual camera, replay buffer and save replay, scene list, studio mode and transitions, show/hide the sources of the scene on air, audio mixer with mute and volume, media control (▶ ⏸ ⏹ ⏭ ⏮), enable/disable filters, scene collections, profiles and screenshots.

🎛️ All of it also becomes a KEY on the Soundboard: create a key, pick the type 🎬 OBS action and then the action. The lists of scenes, sources and filters come from the connected OBS, and ▶ Test now fires it immediately so you can check.
💡 The 🎬 keys LIGHT UP on their own when what they control is on: recording, live, source visible, filter enabled, scene on air. The button shows the state, it doesn’t just fire.
🔀 A 🎬 key fits inside the 🎛️ Multi-action button: the queue mixes sound and command. Switch scene, wait 2 seconds and play the sting — now it’s a single button.

📸 The scene screenshot doesn’t go to the OBS machine’s disk: it comes over the connection and lands straight in the app’s media, ready to become an overlay. Works the same with OBS on another computer on the network.

🎚️ Each block of the control has its own on/off switch in 🧪 Labs → 🎬 OBS Studio: if you only switch scenes, you don’t need the mixer, filters and profiles taking up the screen. Collections and profiles come off, because switching them reloads all of OBS.
🛡️ The app asks OBS what IT can do: a feature your version doesn’t have (chapter markers need OBS 30.2) isn’t even attempted — instead of an error, you get a message explaining.

🔒 Commanding OBS still belongs to the 🎬 switch in restricted mode, inside the Soundboard too: whoever comes in over the network without that switch doesn’t fire the 🎬 keys, not even inside a multi-action button.
🌍 All translated into the 10 languages, with the FAQ and the Labs card updated.

🖼️ FIX: avatars go missing far less. Before, a single network hiccup while fetching someone’s picture wiped THAT person’s picture for the rest of the stream — the failure was cached forever. Now a failure only lasts a few minutes, the next message tries again, Twitch got a second backup source, and an image that fails to load on screen gets one more chance before falling back to coloured initials.

🔍 When you ZOOM an avatar (in the panel and on the public screen), the app asks for the best quality the service has — the YouTube original, Twitch 600×600, Kick "fullsize", Bilibili uncropped — and steps down on its own if the largest doesn’t exist. The picture never comes up empty.

🕒 FIX: comments from the different services no longer cut in front of each other in the unified feed or the general column. YouTube doesn’t deliver comment by comment: it delivers in BATCHES, each carrying a timestamp from a few seconds ago, and that made a batch jump the Twitch and Kick queue. The timeline now follows ARRIVAL ORDER — in the panel, in the public live chat and in the server’s memory. Recovered history (from minutes ago) still goes back to its right place in the past.

📸 Screenshots have clear rules, because a screenshot is a PICTURE OF YOUR SCREEN: at least 3 seconds between one and the next, the app keeps the last 60 (the oldest drops on its own) and, for whoever comes in over the network in restricted mode, it only works with the 🖼️ media switch enabled — and even then only of the scene on air, never of a window of yours that is off air.

🎭 Overlay profiles: the look of the featured comment can now be saved as a complete named TEMPLATE — colors, font, artwork, position and the pieces, all together. Build the look, click ➕ and done: switch the whole overlay in one click with ✨ Use this one (undo with ◀), overwrite with 💾 and delete with 🗑️. The new card lives in the Appearance tab, right below the 🎨.

🎭 AUTOMATIC switch: turn it on and every featured comment wears the right template by itself — one profile for regular comments and one per VALUE BRACKET for Super Chats and 💝 donations (the highest bracket reached wins). The value is converted to Brazilian reais at the day’s exchange rate, in any currency, and the math is done by the program on your computer — the dashboard can’t make up a value.

🧪 Each bracket has a test button: it puts a pretend Super Chat with that value on air, so you see the template REALLY worn before the live. And the 🪜 fills in the 6 classic Super Chat brackets (R$ 1, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100) at once.
✍️ The editor’s sample comment got a character counter: pick the size (5 to 500) and test whether a long comment fits your artwork — the text changes on air instantly.
👥 William Marchiori joins the OBS Social credits as a collaborator (in ℹ️ About and in the README).

🎭+🖼️ Overlay profiles and your own artwork are now ONE THING: art left 🧪 Labs (no longer experimental, no more switch) and the 🖼️ Your artwork section lives inside the 🎭 card, on the Appearance tab. Upload, choose where it goes, done — the art ALWAYS shows.

🖱️ Arrange the screen got the complete template-editing mechanic: the 🎭 Editing selector picks a template and EVERYTHING you change on the featured comment — positions, pieces, colors, font, artwork — is stored in that template by itself, with the preview wearing the template instantly. The live look does not change while you edit; choose «— Live look —» to go back to normal.
🔗 Each template got its own URL: /overlay?perfil=NAME ALWAYS wears that template — you can have an OBS scene with a fixed look, chosen by the URL.

🖥️ The full-screen editor preview learned to fix itself: when a redraw touched the map size mid-flight, it got stuck at a wrong scale and misaligned — now it measures again on the next frame and always matches the map.

0.55.1.titulo: The art is really in charge
itens: 🖼️ "The art IS the card" now delivers COMPLETELY: turned on, the default OBS Social overlay is turned OFF — no dark background, shadow or the usual assembly (photo, name and badges in a row) on top of your art. Only the art stays, with the pieces (photo, name, text, value...) exactly where you place them in 🖱️ Arrange the screen — even with the master 🧩 off. Turn the option off and the usual card comes back intact.
🖱️ The Arrange map follows along: with "The art IS the card" on, the featured pieces show up to drag even without the 🧩 — what you see on the map is what the live shows.

🎯 Each 🎭 automatic bracket now chooses HOW to match, in its own selector: 💰 from an amount in reais up (as before); 🎨 by the COLOR YouTube painted on the Super Chat (the 7 official tones — blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, magenta and red — matched against the real color coming from YouTube, body or header); or 🔤 by a WORD that shows in the name area (the name, «Member», the channel level — the program looks at the name and the badges next to it).

🥇 When more than one bracket fits, the decision order is: color → amount → word → regular comment. The word bracket also works as a fallback for a Super Chat without its own bracket — and dresses regular comments from members.

🧪 Each bracket’s test button follows its type: the color one puts a Super Chat painted with the chosen tone on air; the word one, a comment with the word on the name badge; the amount one, the Super Chat with that amount — always to see the template REALLY worn before the live.
↔️ Old brackets keep working untouched: a bracket without a type is by amount, as it always was.

0.56.1.titulo: Your artwork takes the stage on its own
itens: 🖼️ Picked an artwork for the featured comment background? Done: the OBS Social default overlay leaves the stage ON ITS OWN — no default background, shadow or assembly over your artwork. Only the art stays, with the pieces (photo, name, text, amount...) wherever you place them in 🖱️ Organize the screen. No switch to remember to turn on.

📐 The «how the artwork enters the card» selector (cover/stretch/fit) retired — it no longer made sense with total replacement. The artwork now fills exactly the 🖼️ Your artwork box you draw on the map: the box IS the art.
🧹 The «The art IS the card» switch is gone too: it became the normal behavior. If you already used artwork, nothing to change — everything stays in place, just without extra steps.

0.57.0.titulo: The visual overlay editor, whole, inside OBS Social
itens: 🎨 New page: the visual overlay editor — the complete editor, inside the program. The whole 1920×1080 screen as the workbench, each element (artwork, avatar, name, text and value) as its own figure: drag it, stretch by the blue handle or type the position in PIXELS in the side panels. Opens from the 🎨 button on the 🎭 Overlay profiles card (or straight at /editor).
🗂️ «Select element» bar: each element becomes a chip with its layer (1 to 4) and ▲▼ arrows to move up and down the stack — click it, it is selected; no hunting in lists.

🎭 Everything saves into the same overlay profiles: saving in the editor updates the profile instantly, the 🎭 automatic dresses as before and /overlay?perfil=NAME shows exactly what the editor drew. With Live preview on, every tweak saves itself and a sample comment goes on air.

0.58.0.titulo: The Appearance page reborn: Arrange IS the editor
itens: 🎨 Complete reform: 🖱️ Arrange the screen BECAME the visual overlay editor — in place, inside the Appearance page, no separate page. On top, the profile bar (choose, 💾 save, ✨ wear, 🗑️, ➕ new) and the artwork line with overlay type (Regular comment/Super Chat) and a THUMBNAIL; below the map, the 🗂️ Select element bar; on the side, the PIXEL numbers of whatever is selected.

🗂️ The Layers panel became the «Select element» bar, with ALL elements: featured, pinned chat, frame, every widget — and the pieces of whatever is disassembled. Each chip shows its layer and has ▲▼ arrows to move up/down the stack; click it, it is selected on the map (👁 and 🔒 remain).
🧹 The 🎭 Overlay profiles card is gone: profiles became the editor bar, and the 🎭 automatic and 🖼️ Your artworks live inside the editor, in collapsible blocks — no more duplicated-cards mess.

🩹 And the reason the custom overlay «did not replace the default»: on older installs the 🎭 automatic came EMPTY (no regular profile and no brackets) — turning the switch on did nothing. Now the update fills the factory mapping by itself (regular + 6 Super Chat levels) for anyone who never touched it; switch on, dressed up.

0.59.0.titulo: No fear of mistakes: rescue buttons and boxes that tell the truth
itens: 📏 The Featured box now MEASURES the real card inside the preview — no more out-of-sync estimate: the selection hugs exactly what shows on screen, on the default card and on custom artworks alike (and re-measures itself on every new featured).

📐 Every overlay got Width and Height selectors in pixels on the side panel: widgets, clock, frame (proportional, driving the scale), pinned chat (real), default card (real Width = max width) and artwork card (real Width × Height). And the fields now move the elements IN REAL TIME, at every keystroke.

🟣 On the default card, the side handles of the map stretch the real WIDTH (in px); the «Size %» ruler disappears for the card in artwork/pieces mode (there Width × Height rule — the ruler created a treacherous zoom that misaligned everything).

🧹 Cleaner wording: comparisons with another program left the interface (nobody needs to know another program to understand ours), and About now describes William Marchiori as a collaborator on several elements for OBS Social.

0.59.1.titulo: Precise hand tool and Width×Height on every piece
itens: 🧲 The hand tool is precise again: moving the featured comment drops the CARD exactly where you released the box — on the default card and on the pieces overlay alike (the program compensates by itself the internal anchor that displaced everything).
👁️ A watcher re-measures the real card in the preview every second: turned 🧩 on, an animation ended, a drag dropped — the box re-hugs the card by itself, never hugging a ghost again.

📐 EVERY featured piece got Width and Height on the panel: artwork and text with a real box, name with real width, square avatar (they drive the Size), and value/icon/badges measured in the preview — type it, it resizes.
💰 And the Super Chat stopped showing the amount TWICE on the pieces overlay: the «superchat $5.00» tag from the badges leaves the stage — only our value piece stays, with the conversion to reais.

0.92.0.titulo: 🖼️ Each profile’s artwork is uploaded right there, next to the name
itens: The 🎭 Profile (featured template) bar now has a 🖼️ Artwork for this profile button: type the new profile’s name, upload the image or video, and it is born with the artwork bound to that name. The artwork waits in a thumbnail beside it until you click ➕ New profile (and ✖ drops it).
Created a profile with artwork? It opens by itself in the editor, ready for you to adjust the position, the size and the pieces.
With no name typed, artwork uploaded from that button dresses the template that is open right now — or the live look, if you are not editing any.

Below 🖼️ Overlay artwork there is now a strip with every profile and its artwork drawn: one click opens that template to adjust, the first card is the live look, and the open template is highlighted. The strip follows every artwork you upload or swap, right away.

0.93.0.titulo: 🖼️ Custom artwork breaks free from the default card
itens: The featured artwork is no longer locked to the default overlay’s size: you can stretch it FAR beyond it (up to 400% of the card), by the handles on the map or by the Width and Height sliders. The two now resize independently.

Fixed: moving or stretching the artwork outside the card made it VANISH — the card clipped anything past its edge. Now, when the artwork goes past the card, the card stops clipping and the whole artwork stays on screen.
The artwork can also be dragged well outside the card (from -200% to 300%), to fit exactly the way your piece needs.

The 🖼️ «Overlay (your media)» layer is now 🖼️ «Full-screen frame» — the old name looked like a duplicate next to 🖼️ Your art, but they are different things: this one is the frame covering the whole screen, the other is the comment card’s background.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.94.0.titulo: 🧩 Every overlay element breaks free — and adjustments that travel between templates
itens: What the artwork got last version now applies to ALL overlays and ALL of their elements: the featured card’s avatar, name, badges, value and text, and the widget pieces too (QR, like-o-meter, winstreak, viewers, clock, giveaway). Each piece’s box goes up to 400%, its size up to 1000%, and they can all be dragged well outside (from -200% to 300%). The avatar was the most locked of all: it stopped at 300%.

And nothing vanishes at the edge anymore: when any piece escapes, its overlay stops clipping — for the featured card AND for each widget, one by one. An overlay with everything inside keeps clipping as always, so no template you already built changes its look.
📏 The SIZE of each overlay also had a low ceiling: 250% (200% on the full-screen frame). They all go up to 1000% now — by the toolbar slider, by the handles on the map, or by typing the pixels.

🎯 New «Only what I am editing» switch in the editor bar: hides everything else on the map and leaves only the overlay you are working on, with its pieces. Editor only — the live stream keeps showing everything — and the choice is remembered in this browser.

📋 New «Copy adjustments to...» button in the 🎭 bar: nailed the fit on one template and want the same assembly on the others? Check the destination templates and the adjustments travel — positions, sizes, pieces, colors, all of it. Each template’s artwork and network stay put, which is exactly the case of having different artwork for the same kind of overlay. Want the artwork to come along? There is a checkbox for that.
Security update and internal maintenance.

0.96.0.titulo: 🐛 «Overlay in pieces» no longer invades the live — and 🎯 applies to the preview
itens: IMPORTANT FIX: turning on 🧩 «Overlay in pieces» threw EVERY widget with loose pieces onto the live stream, even the ones turned OFF — 8 at once, mid-broadcast. Now the pieces box only applies to a widget that is actually on screen; the ones turned off stay off.

So nothing useful is lost, a widget with loose pieces still shows in the editor PREVIEW even with no data at all — that is what gives you something to drag its pieces on. Editor only: the live sees none of it.

🎯 «Only what I am editing» now applies to the preview too. Before it hid only the map rectangles while the preview kept showing the whole overlay — that is what seemed to "come back" when you turned 🧩 on.
And the widget that stops clipping when a piece escapes (v0.94) now gets it right when the widget appears later too: before, a still-hidden widget measured zero and the check came out wrong.
